excerpt: I play Ace Attorney with some unexpected aspects.
title: The Playing Ace Attorney Dream
content:
In this dream, I was playing [[Ace Attorney|Ace Attorney (Series)]] on my [[3DS]] on the blue recliner in the living room (shown in the image). The clear table wasn't there, and my dad was standing in place of where it once was while having a conversation with my brother who was beside him (also shown in the image). The only other thing I remember at that point in the dream was [[Phoenix Wright]] had a new sprite that was his hand slamming down on the desk sprite, except only his front hand was slammed down. That part of the dream also took place during the [[post trial wrap-up|Post Trial Wrap-Up]], and in a [[capture card]] like perspective as opposed to my POV like in the first part.

Unlike the end of most Ace Attorney cases, this one ended on a very sombre note, and the only way to make it a little bit less sad was to trade someone an [[Ekans]] for a [[Bellsprout]] (or the other way around, I can’t remember). The final piece of information that I remember is the music during the post trial wrap-up. The music was an instrumental version of the [[Dango theme]], specifically the version from [[Clannad the Motion Picture]], that was remixed to make it sound sad. It also sounded like the start of either the [[SL-9 Incident recollection theme]] or the [[Steel Samurai's Ballad recollection theme]] from Ace Attorney were mixed in there as well.
thoughts: To be honest, this is the like the definition of a generic weird dream. It's not interesting or funny, it just has things in it that are unexplained or strange. It's not good, but it's not bad, and unless a dream is a nightmare, or doesn't really have anything to it, I don't think there will be anything below a 5. That's to say, this dream gets the lowest rating it can get without me actively not liking it. Not bad, not good, just boring relatively speaking to dreams as a whole.

excerpt: I get chased down by the titular YouTuber.
title: The Binging With Babish Dream
content: In this dream, the guy from the [[YouTube]] channel [[Binging With Babish]] was chasing me down the hallway of my grandparents (on my dad's side) house. Once he got me in front of the front door in the dining room, he tased me with a taser made from a battery. After that, my arm that he tased went numb, but it didn't hurt, and then he said something to me along the lines of "didn't hurt did it?"
thoughts: As interesting as this dream may seem, compared to what normal have, it's not that interesting. For me personally, one thing that makes a dream interesting is having a lot of different elements to it, which this one clearly does not. Also, despite the situation, it wasn't scary either, which might have actually made it more interesting. It's still strange, and not something that would happen in real life, but pretty average in terms of dreams.

excerpt: A Clannad related dream that takes place in a classroom.
title: The Clannad School Dream
content:
This dream takes place in my ninth grade science room, except all the desks were facing the other white board (left instead of forward, as shown in the layout image). The teacher was some generic anime teacher with no face, just writing things on the white board. Then another person with no face came to the door of the classroom, and they had two 5-year-old children with them. Both of the children looked like [[Ushio Okazaki]] from [[Clannad]] except they both had [[Dangos|Dango (Clannad)]] for heads. They sat down in seats near the back of the class, and the person who had brought them there left.

I looked two seats to my left (the one directly beside me was empty) and nodded to [[Nagisa Furukawa]] (specifically wearing her Winter outfit) who then proceeded to get up from her seat, take a giant Dango plushie, and place it over the teacher's head. After Nagisa went back to her seat, the now Dango-headed teacher just stood there, and that's how the dream ended.
thoughts: This is a bit of a strange dream. Clannad is my favourite anime of all time, and this is one of the few dreams I've had involving it, so it gets a plus for that. The surreal image of both a person with no face and a person with a Dango for a head are pretty neat, too. That's for having this one, brain!

excerpt: I go through a black and white town.
title: The Black And White Town Dream
content: In this dream, I was walking around this town that was completely in grey scale, and covered by a mist. I knew I was in a dream, and by extension, knew that I had to die if I wanted to escape, so I tried getting run over by a train. I was still asleep, but I had a health bar, so I tried getting run over by a car next and that woke me up.
thoughts: I had this dream all the way back when I was a kid, so I don't know why I was so intent on leaving the dream, and I can't even remember if I was lucid or not. I do remember the town looking pretty cool, and I liked the vibe of it, in spite of this dream not having much to it.

excerpt: A middle school and anime heavy dream taking place in a gym.
title: The Ram In The School Locker Room Dream
content:
This dream takes place in the gym from my middle school (shown in the layout image). The first thing that happened is that I and some other people did a performance that was very colourful in some way. Apparently there were children on some sort of scaffolding on the stage as well. I was going to distract them to get them down, but I was [[Roronoa Zoro]] from [[One Piece]] and I wanted to keep that a secret, so to keep that secret I used two swords, and for safety, they were wooden (instead of three real swords).

Apparently, all of the other people who were in the performance were now either fooling around in the gym or trying to clean up somewhere not on the stage. After trying to get the kids down (and succeeding, I think) I went to the location shown in the layout image where my friend Victor was. Victor was holding three of those weird, cheap, metal curtain rods, and I was holding three of them in place of my two wooden swords.

Then [[Ram]] from [[Re:Zero]] appeared, except she was different in a few ways. She was wearing casual clothes, and had the same personality as her sister [[Rem]] (and by "same personality," I mean she was nice and seemed interested in me like how Rem is interested in [[Subaru|Subaru Natsuki]]). Ram said that she was interested in a boy that she mentioned by name in the dream, but it was a name that I never heard before. She said that to try and make me jealous, and then Victor complimented her hair. Then I think I tried to compliment her, but didn’t do it very well, and then Victor complimented her again.

After that, I said that I needed to put my curtain rods in my bag, but Victor offered to take them (take as in keep because I didn’t really want them) and then left after I gave them to him. I needed to go get my bag anyway, and as I was running to the locker room, I turned to Ram while still running and said something like, "your hair looks really nice." Ram then said she needed the washroom, telling me to wait for her. But, I ignored her because I thought to myself that it would still be fine for me to get my bag.

When I got to the locker room area, [[Caden]] was with me, and we both walked into the doorway leading to the locker room. But instead of it being just two doors, it was an airport-esque area. Both me and Caden went to the left where the locker room was, but as soon as we were right in front of it, I realized it was the women's locker room.

For some reason, Caden went inside, but I left and walked over to the left wall where the boys locker room was. When I was almost there, Ram came out from the door and came over to me. She followed me to the locker room area, which was the same as the other one but without the airport part. I accidentally opened the door to the bathroom, and when I turned around to leave, Ram lightly pushed me in and came in with me. She was right in front of me, and as she was pulling me closer, I thought she was going for a kiss, but she was going for a hug. We hugged for a very long time, and while we were hugging, I heard somebody come in. But due to the position of the hug, I couldn’t see them.

As we were still hugging, the dream started to fade into a black screen with a movie ticket on it, with the text on the movie ticket saying something like "the reason why that hug felt so real is because your hand is between your legs." Then I woke up, and sure enough, I was in a position where my hand was between my legs.
thoughts: What makes this dream for me is the ending. The rest is pretty cool too; as cringe as it may be to say, dreams where fictional characters are "real" are pretty cool. But the fact that it ended with a reference to my real life state and having it be true was pretty crazy. I probably have more dreams than the average person since I write them down, which makes me have more dreams, but this is still one of a kind even with that.

excerpt: Someone I knew starts a gambling ring.
title: The Bradley S. Gambling Dream
content: This dream starts at the end of a middle school day. I was outside the school, and had known that a school day had passed. But I couldn’t remember any of it, so I went back inside the school to try and find out what happened. I went to a place that doesn't actually exist in the school; it was a dimly lit hallway with a high ceiling and was really wide. There were police officers roaming around, and once I asked what was going on, one of the officers said that [[Bradley S.]] started an underground gambling ring in the school.
thoughts: This is a fairly normal dream by dream standards, but since I didn't get to see the actual gambling ring, it wasn't that interesting. In fact, the thing that jumps out to me is that I couldn't remember the school day that had happened, and actually acted upon that.

excerpt: A dream about my friend group including Ace Attorney characters.
title: The Ace Attorney Friend Group Dream
content:
This dream starts with me, [[Trucy Wright]], [[Apollo Justice]] and [[Klavier Gavin]] walking through a familiar feeling tunnel. It wasn’t first person; the camera (so to speak) was at the end of the tunnel, with us coming toward it. Apollo and Klavier were wearing casual clothes, and Trucy was wearing a kimono. Trucy and I were walking side by side, while Apollo and Klavier were also walking side by side, just a bit behind and to the left of us.

There was also an alcove in the tunnel, as shown in the layout image. As we all were walking, Trucy stepped on something pointy (for some reason she wasn’t wearing shoes), so me and her went over to the alcove. Also, at this point, it switched to my POV. Apollo and Klavier were just talking while this was happening, and I was trying to see if Trucy was okay (I think). Then my friends [[Pamela]] and [[Vern]] came from the tunnel, and when they did is when I took Trucy back the way we came.
thoughts: Apollo Justice is probably the Ace Attorney game I think about the least, but I really do like the characters, so this was nice. I also had this dream all the way back when I was in middle school, so there's a good chance I was playing it at the time. Still, it's not really that wacky for a dream.

excerpt: I meet the YouTuber Scott the Woz.
title: The Scott The Woz Dream
content: I was walking from [[Lawtons|Lawtons Drugs]] to my home and I met the [[YouTuber]] [[Scott the Woz]]. I think I specifically met him when I crossed the cross-walk (shown in the layout image), and maybe walked a little past that part of the way home. Also, although this is obviously a real location, it felt slightly weird. And, although I had this dream before [[The Philosophy Dream]], I would describe it as having similar vibes.
thoughts: There's not much to say about this one. Despite me meeting someone I would be ecstatic to meet in real life, it was just treated as normal in the dream. As a result, this gets below the average of 5 on the premise that it's a bad take on something that would be good in real life.

excerpt: I go out with some friends and do strange things.
title: The Weird Outing Dream
content:
I was walking down an unknown street at night, and once I reached the end of it there were two houses, one to my left and one in front of me (like shown in the layout image). The area was covered with Christmas-like lights, and it all looked quite beautiful. I saw my friend [[Nina]] go into the house in front of me, and I was confused because we planned on going somewhere. Then, I saw the [[YouTuber]] [[RelaxAlax]] waving off both Nina and [[Pamela]] from the house.

For some reason, Pamela was wearing Nina’s peach-coloured sweater, and Nina was wearing Pamela’s blue sweater. Then, the dream cut to Nina and me at our bus terminal next to our high school, and Nina was inviting me into the elevator to do something. I was hesitant because I didn't want to worry my parents, but I looked at the time (I think on my phone, but I’m not sure) and it said something like 1 in the morning, which meant I would already be worrying them, so I joined her.

The elevator led up to a room which seemed to be a classroom I have never been in before. Me, Pamela, and Nina were near the middle of the room, making some sort of food on a lab-like table. My [[11th grade physics teacher|Mr. Physics 11]] then came in at around 2 AM, and he asked us if we were on our shift. I didn’t know what to say, but then he said "your next shift is at 5:30 right?" We said yes and then he left. We clearly weren’t supposed to be there because he came back to try and catch us, but all that was left was a cartoony sack on the table.
thoughts: I really liked the start of this dream, mostly because of the visual. Obviously, only I know exactly what it looked like, but I'd assume most know what it's like to see a neighbourhood at night during Christmastime. It was something I could easily see in real life given the right time of year, but it was nice to see in a dream, too. I could give or take the rest of the dream, since it was a little weird, but nothing too interesting. I don't have too many dreams that definitely take place during night, so I appreciate this one for that as well.

excerpt: One of my friends turns into Sans Undertale.
title: The Pamela Sans Dream
content: In this dream, I was at my middle school, and I was waiting for my friend [[Pamela]] at the front of the school. She was walking around the school, and when I met up with her, she turned into [[Sans]] from the video game [[Undertale]]. After she turned into Sans, the dream cut to the house from the movie [[The Hate U Give]], where both me and Pamela were playing video games.
thoughts: Although short, my brain did a good job on this one with the strangeness of one of my friends turning into Sans. This dream was also one of it's time, since I was obsessed with Undertale, and specifically Sans at the time, and we had just watched The Hate U Give for school.

excerpt: I run around my elementary school with my brother.
title: The Running At Elementary School Dream
content: This dream starts with my brother and I running around my elementary school. I was running like [[Mario]] when he has his arms outstretched with the [[Super Star]]. Then I went to run to the left, but he told me that was the wrong way. When I went running back around the school, I collected a [[Propeller Box]], which gave me a [[Luigi]] hat with a [[Tanooki Suit]] hat overtop. So I continued running and doing Propeller Box jumps sometimes. When we went to go down the hill, my brother was on his bike and I tripped. I then got back up and ran toward the road overpass.
thoughts: Although I don't think I had this dream during elementary school, I did have this dream a long time ago, and I would probably say middle school era at the soonest, so that's 3 years after elementary school tops. The reason I point this out is that dreams from before I started writing dreams down, especially the older they are, are a bit more interesting to me. It's like a very skewed image of who I was back then, that being very childish, haha. Either way, I really liked the feeling of running around in this dream; it felt so freeing. I would honestly give this dream a higher rating, but I don't like giving out .5 scores on scales of 10, and I don't think it's quite a 7.

excerpt: I go up a hill in an anime style.
title: The Anime Dream
content: This dream was fully animated in a modern 2010s anime style. I remember being reminded of [[Fruits Basket]] (the modern version), but I don’t know if the dream took place in the same universe or if that was just the style. The only other things I remember is that there was a woman (possibly in a sundress) and that I was either walking past her on a hill or walking with her up a hill.
thoughts: The most interesting part of this dream is the actual style of it. Sadly, nothing interesting happened with that! I've had dreams where I was in anime, or there were anime characters in my dreams, but this is the only one that for sure actually had the anime style to it. If anything even slightly interesting happened, this would be a 10/10, but sadly that's not the case.

excerpt: I have amnesia and travel around semi-familiar places.
title: The Classical Amnesia Dream
content:
In this dream, I had amnesia and was walking around a different version of a boardwalk that I used to walk on all the time, which was very maze-like. It looked like the one in the image, but with trees surrounding it, and some parts weren't over the water. It was also very broken, and parts of it were only barely poking out of the water. Eventually I made it out of the boardwalk area, and it led to my local city.

That was the point where classical music started playing in a non-diegetic fashion. I started walking around the city, trying to ask people about my memories. I remember the scene when I first entered the city (and the last scene of the entire dream), I was standing there with a bunch of trees behind me (where the boardwalk was) and the skyscrapers in front of me all cinematic like.
thoughts: A pretty darn interesting dream, if I do say so myself. The amnesia part was interesting, and even more interesting is that I wasn't scared or anything because of that. I just wanted to know about my history, no fear or anxiety about it. The location was also pretty cool, but the most interesting part to me is actually the music. I have the uncanny ability to perfectly make, or recreate, music in my head when I'm sleeping, and the classical music in this dream is an example of that. Of course, I'm not a musician, so this is nothing more than something cool, but hey, I bet the musicians are jealous.

excerpt: I walk down a street with my friends and then end up in a classroom with my Philosophy teacher.
title: The Philosophy Dream
content:
In this dream, I was walking home from high school on my street, but with the intent of going to school. It was the same part of the street from [[The Scott The Woz Dream]], and had similar vibes as well. As I was walking, I saw [[Pamela]] up ahead and waving to me, and we started walking together. Then [[Jan]] joined us as we continued to walk. After that, [[my Philosophy teacher|Mr. Philosophy]] ran up to us from the road, did a spin and then jumped up on some rocks, all while wearing a backwards hat.

I then pointed behind me at him and said, "he’s just trying to be cool." He then joined us. At the same time, [[Bradley M.]] and [[Sam|Sam (Male)]] joined us by just appearing, and they were both wearing mismatched shoes, which I was going to point out, but I didn’t. Then it cut to us at the grade 12 doors of our high school (shown in the layout images), but the sign said "love u" in the style of the letters being rearranged, i.e. a ransom note.

Then it cut again to [[my English teacher|Mr. High School English]]'s classroom, who also taught me history, and it was taking place during history. For some reason, Bradley M. was sitting at the table next to us, and my Philosophy teacher was standing by the window at that table. Whenever I looked at him, he had the Philosophy classroom behind him in a shadow like fashion. He then pointed out that Bradley M. was wearing mismatched shoes.
thoughts: The most interesting part of this dream to me is the visual of looking at someone, and the "shadow" they cast being a different location. The ransom note style letters, and the fact that I was walking away from school to get to school were cool as well. I've certainly had stranger and more enjoyable dreams, but this is still an above average dream.

excerpt: I find a modded copy of one of my favourite games.
title: The Modded Brawl Dream
content: In this dream, I was in a game store that I’ve never seen before, but it looked a lot like various game stores I’ve seen in commercials and television (the ones from the [[Rivals 60 EB Games Commercial]] and [[The Big Bang Theory]] being the best examples, but not perfect). The whole store was almost blindingly white, the shelves, floor, ceiling, everything. I was in between two shelves, and on one of the shelves I saw a modded (aka [[rom hacked|rom hack]]) copy of [[Super Smash Bros. Brawl]] (I don’t believe it was a preexisting mod, but I could be wrong).
thoughts: I have a lot of nostalgia for Super Smash Bros. Brawl. It was the first Super Smash Bros. game I ever played, and introduced me to pretty much every character in it other than the Mario characters, Link, and Sonic. So, having a dream about it makes sense, but is cool. I also had this dream before I even knew how to hack my Wii, so back then, I was having a dream about something impossible. Now, the fact that I could get up and play Project M right now almost makes this dream feel "complete."

excerpt: My dad gets angry at the state of the weather.
title: The Snowing In May Dream
content: I woke up and heard my dad saying something from the living room. So I got up to see what was going on, and saw that he was mad, so I asked him why. He just pointed to the living room window and said something like "see for yourself," so I parted the window curtain to see that it was snowing in May.
thoughts: Yeah, this is a fairly boring one. There's nothing really negative about it, but it still gets below a 5 for being that boring. This is just something that happens in real life, and it's not anything particularly interesting in real life.

excerpt: I go into a creepy office.
title: The Shadow Office Nightmare Dream
content:
In this dream, I was walking outside the front of an office building. The entire thing was stylized in a black and white way, but not because it was actually in black and white, but because large, ominous shadows were being cast by everything. I went inside the building, and the front wall that I walked past was mostly a set of large square windows.

The room itself was almost completely empty except for a set of stairs leading upwards at the left side of the room, and a chair in the very middle of the room. Someone was sitting in the chair, and I believe that it was my mother. I had an ominous feeling and I believe it was because she was either dead or a fake.
thoughts: I actually don't have that many nightmares (which hopefully I'm not jinxing things right now), but this is one of the few. It really felt quite scary, especially since i had this one when I was much younger. I don't know what could even get a one at this point though, because this gets a 3 since it's kind of interesting to have a nightmare since I have so few, and because nothing scary actually happened.

excerpt: I go into a creepy office again, but it turns into my friends house.
title: The Shadow Office Nightmare Sequel Dream
content:
This is a sequel to [[The Shadow Office Nightmare Dream]], and it started in the same location. I remember that I was in the room from that dream, and then the next thing I remember is that I was running up the stairs from something. The stairs were the ones from [[James]]’s house, and when I got to the top of the stairs, it turned into a completely different dream.

I was upstairs in James's house and the only one who was there was his [[mom|James' Mom]] in the kitchen. I remember I was playing a game on his [[Wii U]] which was a mix of [[New Super Mario Bros. U]] and [[Super Mario 3D World]]. The world map was from 3D world and the levels were from Mario U. Both the world map and levels were completely original and took place at sunset. The level I played was at sunset and a rocky level as well. I also vaguely remember playing it multiplayer, despite being the only one playing.
thoughts: Just like I don't have that many nightmares, I also don't have many dreams that I would consider to be direct sequels. But, this is one of them. The act of being chased upstairs by something I couldn't see was truly terrifying, too. Like, this is the only dream where that has happened, so that almost makes it even more frightening. It also changing into a completely different dream while also definitely being the same dream was strange, and doesn't happen too often to me either.

excerpt: I experience a 2D Mario-like level.
title: The Co-Op Dream
content: I was in the co-op (a place I used to live which basically had small apartments house hybrid living spaces) and going down a very linear sidewalk; it felt like a video game. In retrospect, it reminds me of the scene in [[The Super Mario Bros. Movie]] (the 2023 one) where [[Mario]] and [[Luigi]] are running to get to their client in time, and it’s meant to look like a 2D Mario level. It felt like that but more like a puzzle game as there were small parts of buildings I had to go over and under. I believe that our neighbours, a family of three that we sometimes hung out with, where also there. I don’t know if I talked to them, but at the very least they gave off [[NPC]] energy.
thoughts: Other than the Mario stuff, this is a pretty basic dream, but I only used that as a comparison, so this is a pretty basic dream, with nothing interesting really happening. The puzzle aspect was pretty neat though, I wish I could remember it more.

excerpt: Hatsune Miku tells me wrong information about the Japanese language.
title: The Moose Miku Dream
content: This dream starts in the clouds, and felt very heavenly. [[Hatsune Miku]] descended down in front of me, and she was wearing a wedding-like dress instead of her normal getup. I didn't have an image for that at first, but of course, there's a Miku for everything, so the figure below is kind of what she looked like. She told me that the word "Miku" means moose in Japanese (which isn't true, for the record) and that’s how the dream ended.
thoughts: This dream gets instant bonus points for becoming a bit of an inside joke between me and my friends. It has a really good "bring up" factor. Like, "I had a dream where Miku told me her name means moose" is such a strong phrase, and then there's a bit to elaborate on without it being too long. I also just really like the image of a heavenly Miku, it's really nice. In fact, as I'm writing this, this dream is getting bumped up to an 8.

excerpt: I play a game from a previous dream.
title: The New Super Mario Bros. Dream
content: I was playing the same game from [[The Shadow Office Nightmare Sequel Dream]], though this dream may have come first. I also don't remember if the game was different in anyway, but I do vaguely remember a world map, which I think was just the same as [[Super Mario 3D World]], just with a layout unique to the dream. I also remember that I was playing the game in a weird room that kind of reminded me of my grandmother's (on my mom's side) old living room, shown in the image. The only other thing I remember is that one of my cousins was there as well.
thoughts: There's not too much to say about this one, especially if it did take place before The Shadow Office Nightmare Dream, since it makes the game's appearance in that dream a little less special. It's cool that the same not real game appeared in two dreams, though.

excerpt: Captain Canuck gets mad at America.
title: The Captain Canuck Dream
content: To start with, I wasn't in this dream at all. It was just like I was watching what was happening as if it were a movie. From what I can remember, [[Captain Canuck]] was in a city and trying to save people. I’m also pretty sure that he was also getting mad at the country of America because he didn’t align with them. What that means, I don't know.
thoughts: Considering I've only ever read one Captain Canuck comic book, I'm surprised I had a dream about him. At the very least, I think I had this dream around when I read said comic book. Other than the specific character, this one could be more interesting.

excerpt: I fight Dio from JoJo's Bizarre Adventure.
title: The Dio Fight Dream
content: I need to first start by saying that this dream has spoilers for [[JoJo's Bizarre Adventure]]! So don't read further if you want to remain spoiler free for that series. So, in this dream, I was fighting [[DIO]] from JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure in the living room of my grandmother's house on my dad's side (shown in the layout image). For the most part, at the start, I was just trying to survive. But I wasn’t scared, and I had the fighting spirit to survive. Then, as I got thrown into the television, breaking it in the process, someone told me (I can’t remember who) that I had awakened my stand. My stand was [[Star Platinum]] (even though I wasn’t [[Jotaro Kujo]]) and the dream ended with me freezing time.
thoughts: A really interesting one if I do say so myself. I mean, it's not everyday you have a dream about being in an anime fight and getting thrown into a TV. It would definitely get a point docked if this dream was properly scary, and I was fighting for my life. But the scary dreams are also pretty cool when your not actually going though them.

excerpt: I experience the online game Pokémon Planet in real life.
title: The Pokémon Planet Dream
content: I was at [[Tim Hortons]] and as I was leaving from there across the street, right next to the path where we normally walk home (shown in the layout image) was a [[Pokémon]] gym. I knew that it was specifically a [[Pokémon Planet]] gym because I was playing the game a lot at the time. It was a water type gym that looked almost the same as the [[Cerulean City]] gym, and my [[middle school math teacher|Mx. Middle School Math]] was running it. The last thing I remember is the dream cutting to me leaving while pinning the [[Cascade badge]] to my lapel.
thoughts: Pokémon Planet was something I was obsessed with back in the day, so it's only natural that I would have a dream about it. I mean, there was nothing Pokémon Planet specific, but hey, I knew it was the game in the dream, and that's all that really matters. It's also cool how it was in real life.

excerpt: A scene from the anime Miss Caretaker of Sunohara-sou happens.
title: The Sunohara-Sou Dream
content: To start with, I was watching [[Miss Caretaker of Sunohara-sou]] at the time, and not only is it really bad and I would not recommend it, but it's probably the piece of media I like the least that I've had a dream about. In terms of that actual dream, it was just a still screen from the pool episode of the anime of the main character that had subtitles (despite me watching the dub) that said, "you want to tell me what just happened?" That's it.
thoughts: It's kind of interesting for a dream to just be a still image from an anime. Of course, I would pretty much rather it be an image from any other anime, but hey, my dreams are heavily based on recent events, so I suppose I should be complaining to my past self for watching a 2/10 anime in the first place. It would still be kind of a boring dream if it was an anime I liked, but because it was specifically one I really didn't, this one is a 4 out of 10.

excerpt: I drink coffee that tastes bad.
title: The Coffee Dream
content: I remember this dream being a POV perspective, and it either took place at my counter where my coffee machines are, or on some fictional counter, I can't really remember. The whole dream was just me making a coffee and then drinking it from a first-person perspective, and it tasted bad. I also kind of remember the perspective being a little more top down than it should have been when I went to drink the coffee.
thoughts: This is another one of those dreams that just... Has happened to me in real life. Sometimes you make bad coffee, you don't need to dream about it if you ask me. But I did, I guess, and it didn't really feel any different to how it happens in real life.

excerpt: I almost get run over by a train from Thomas.
title: The Diesel 10 Dream
content: This dream was shot in one of those train documentary style shots where it pans at the side of the railroad tracks. [[Diesel 10]] from [[Thomas And The Magic Railroad]] was speeding down the rails, and I was tied to the tracks like an old-timey cartoon. I then woke up right before I got run over.
thoughts: I had this dream back when I was a kid, and Thomas and Friends was my favourite thing in the world. Despite absolutely loving Thomas And The Magic Railroad, I was still scared of Diesel 10, so it's only natural I would have a dream like this. From what I remember, it wasn't that scary, but I think that was because it was so short. I think it's kind of a cool thing to have a dream about in retrospect, though.

excerpt: Vegeta fights something while me and my friends watch.
title: The Vegeta Fight Dream
content: My friends, [[Oliver]], Mat]], [[Nina]], as well as [[Vegeta]] from [[Dragon Ball|Dragon Ball Z]] were in a weird living room with me, and I was [[Goku]]. We were behind a couch, and there was something we had to fight, but only Vegeta went to fight it. We were all watching, but then Oliver died and Mat disappeared. I still somehow said to Oliver, "I was gonna use this for myself, but you need it more than me," and I tried to give Oliver the spinach I apparently had behind my back. Oliver refused and then disappeared again (despite him already having disappeared). Vegeta continued fighting and I think he won. Then Mat and Oliver walked into the room like nothing happened.
thoughts: A very interesting one indeed. First off, I find it kind of interesting that I was Goku but that really didn't have anything to do with the dream, and that would be a downside if this dream was short, or didn't have much else to it, but that's not the case. Second, I find it kind of cool how the fight with Vegeta and the thing I can't remember was happening in the background while me and friends were doing our thing; I feel like that doesn't happen that often in my dreams. Finally, the weird stuff with Oliver not being there, but also somehow being there was pretty cool as well.

excerpt: I find a game that's on a console it's not really on.
title: The 3DS Super Mario 3D World Dream
content: I was at a weird game store in a part of town I normally don't go to, and there was a [[3DS]] section that I was looking at. It had [[Super Mario 3D World]], but instead of being for the [[Wii U]] like it normally is, it was for the 3DS. Along with it, there was also a [[Mario]] game that had an off-centred rainbow 8-bit Mario sprite on it, which I think was also Super Mario 3D World, just with different box art.
thoughts: Playing video games is one of my hobbies, so it's always neat to me when I have a dream about them, especially ones that don't exist. In this case, the games in this dream kind of sort of exist, just not on the 3DS, or with the box art in the dream. Other than the games, there's not much else to this dream, despite it being enjoyable.

excerpt: Mary Jane Watson has unrequited love for me.
title: The MJ Dream
content: This dream starts with me sitting at a table with [[Mary Jane Watson]] and another woman. I was in love with this said other woman and MJ knew it. She said something like "at least let me give you this," and then kissed me on either the cheek or the lips, I can’t remember which. She was very sad about it because she knew that I didn’t love her.
thoughts: A short, but bittersweet dream. Love is always something strange when it comes to dreams, because in real life it's quite the mystery, so when you add dreams into the mix, it really gets messed up sometimes. This isn't really one of those times though, it's kind of a love triangle, which is still interesting, just not strange. Another thing I've noticed is that often when I'm in love in a dream, it's not with a preexisting person or character, it's always someone who's a dream original. I wonder if that means anything, or if that's common or what.

excerpt: I make a train layout and my elementary school.
title: The Elementary School Train Table Dream
content: I was at the playground at my elementary school, and there was a train table at the bottom left of the area. I used a randomizer app to randomly add the Thomas train tracks to the layout, and grandmother on my dad's side voice was there trying to make sure I finished the layout by the end of the day. I left and then when I returned to the table, two women from my grade 12 Math class were sitting at it like a normal table. When I went over, they were gone and there was sand all over the table, but it wasn’t very messy to clean off. I was going to continue the layout, but I looked to my left and there was a beach with the tide coming in and out pretty fast, so the dream ended with me trying to take the table.
thoughts: I wouldn't say this dream starts interesting, but it does get there, and the idea of me doing something I did as a kid (other than randomly selecting the tracks) in different location, still from when I was a kid, is kind of cool to me. But, specifically the end, where all of a sudden there was a beach was really cool. The fact that it was "foreshadowed" by there being sand on the train table is kind of crazy as well.

excerpt: I find an Angry Birds plush I already have.
title: The Angry Bird Plush Dream
content: In this dream, I remember cleaning my room and going through my stuff and I found a new plush of [[Red|Red (Angry Birds)]] the [[Angry Bird|Angry Birds]] I already have, and am 90% sure is a fake (shown in the image below). Since I already had one in real life, I gave it to my brother, who inspected it then accepted it.
thoughts: Typically when I have dreams about specific objects, it's either objects I have a strong connection to, or something that I really want. Yet, in this dream, it was something I don't really care about, and already have. In fact, as you probably read, I decided to give it away, and even my brother had to inspect it before taking it. Very strange indeed.

excerpt: Me and a friend pitch The Big Bang Theory.
title: The Big Bang Theory Dream
content: In this dream, my friend [[Jan]] and I were tasked with pitching a pilot for a show to [[CBC]], and we ended up showing off an alternate version of [[The Big Bang Theory]] (which didn’t exist yet, and this dream did feel like it took place around 2003, before it existed). We were in an office-like room that kind of reminded me of my high school Physics lab, but with your standard grey office colours. Jan and I were showing our pilot off on a projector, and I don’t remember exactly what was different about our version, but I remember it reminding me of the actual, unaired Big Bang Theory pilot. I knew what the real Big Bang Theory pilot was about, so I was trying to manipulate the director into actually making the real pilot based on our pitch. The last thing I remember was a different scene with me sitting at a table with [[Nina]] and [[Pamela]] discussing how hard it was to make a show.
thoughts: At the time I had this dream, I specifically remember watching a video about the unaired Big Bang Theory pilot, so that's probably why I had this dream. I really like the aspect of me having to manipulate the people we were pitching it to to create the actual pilot. It kind of had a "man against the world" type of vibe since I was the only one who knew about the actual pilot, and it felt like I was trying to make sure the future didn't get messed up.

excerpt: I'm a character from a story I work on and almost get run over.
title: The Arc Story Dream
content: I was [[Arcueid Brunestud|Arcueid Brunestud (Arc)]] from a story I work on in my free time sometimes that I've titled [[Arc]], and I was wearing a wedding-like dress. I was running down a hill away from my middle school, and as I was going across the street, I almost got hit by a car.
thoughts: Dreams where I'm someone I'm not are interesting, especially when it's a character I created! For the record, though, the name of my character does have the same name of the character from Tsukihime, but that's just because I couldn't think of a name, and I got attached to that temporary one. Anyway, yeah, a lot of people wish they were someone they're not, so having a dream about that is neat, even if I wouldn't say that applies to me completely. But, other than that aspect, I almost get hit by a car, which is not very cool.

excerpt: I knit a bisexual flag.
title: The Bisexual Flag Dream
content: I was knitting a bisexual flag coloured sweater over the area to the right of my TV (shown in one of the below images). I believe at the time, instead of what's in there in the image, my small Mario standee (shown in one of the below images), PlayStation 2, and Super Nintendo Entertainment System were there, but I can’t say for sure. The flag was about two thirds finished, with the bottom half needing finishing, but then I woke up.
thoughts: Kind of a strange location for a dream. I don't knit, nor am I bisexual (though, I do have friends who are) so that's a bit odd, too. It's all relatively grounded in reality though, and should something strike me, I could imagine wanting to learn how to knit, a making a flag of some sort. So really, the funny part is that despite the oddness of this dream, the only thing I wouldn't potentially do is knit in that exact location, because why wouldn't I just do it somewhere more comfortable?

excerpt: I get married, but it gets interrupted.
title: The Wedding Dream
content: This dream starts at my own wedding (for the record, I've yet to be married). It was very similar to the early wedding scenes from the anime/manga [[The Quintessential Quintuplets]], where the person I was marrying was faceless in the sense that they did have a face, but it was always obscured/generic. I started to hear the wedding bells, but I realized that the sound was actually my real world alarm clock, and when I made that realization I woke up.
thoughts: This dream sounds so fake it's actually unreal. I mean, an alarm clock being apart of the dream, and when I realize it, I wake up? That's something that only happens in media, right? Well, apparently not. I've had "meta" dreams before, but to me, this is the craziest because of how staged it sounds. Even though it's short, I can't even say I wish there was more to it considering how picture perfect it is.

excerpt: My friend runs a café.
title: The Victor Café Dream
content: I was at a café that was run by my friend Victor, and he was selling items from [[Tim Hortons]] (I most specifically remember [[Timbits]]). The café vaguely reminded me of the bakery from [[Clannad]], with the wooden floors and glass display cases. At some point, a bunch of kids came either running to or from the back of the café.
thoughts: A strange dream, but not incredibly so. At the very least, you can see where all the parts come from. A location run by a friend, that looks like a location from my favourite anime, and has items from a place that I go to a lot. It all adds up... Though, I guess I don't know where the random children come from. But hey, despite me explaining why this dream makes sense, it doesn't have to make sense, haha.

excerpt: I date Leela from Futurama.
title: The Leela Dream
content: I was with [[Leela|Turanga Leela]] from [[Futurama]], and we were on a date. I remember that this dream had a pretty good vibe to it, as well. The only other thing I remember is that we were bowling together, and we were enjoying it.
thoughts: A short dream, but not a bad one. I think I would probably put in in the dream graveyard if I was writing it down now, but I have a big Google Doc with all my dreams, and this one was in the standard batch. I really like Futurama, but I don't think about it too much, and I don't think I had this dream when I was watching the show, so this was a "latent idea" type of dream, which is always cool. I have dreams about things and people I haven't thought about for a long time often, and funnily enough, I end up thinking about them more from writing down my dreams.

excerpt: I lay down next to a beautiful woman.
title: The Woman Dream
content: I was laying down next to an extremely beautiful woman that I’ve never met before. She had long blonde hair, and she was wearing red lipstick. We were looking at each other, and although there was nothing sexual between us, I was a little embarrassed.
thoughts: Simple, but nice. Who doesn't want to lay down in bed with a beautiful woman? I mean, there are probably a lot of people who don't, but that's besides the point, and there was nothing sexual anyway. I know there's not much to this dream, but it has a very pleasant aura, so it gets rated relatively high.

excerpt: I go inside a house that an amalgamation of houses.
title: The Crazy House Dream
content:
Me and a bunch of people from my grade nine class (I most specifically remember [[Bradley S.]]) were invited to a mansion. The outside reminded me of a mix of [[Azuki|Miho Azuki]]'s house from the [[Bakuman]] manga, the house from [[Home Alone]], and [[Kouko|Kouko Ibuki]]’s house from [[Clannad]].

The inside was very maze-like, and I went through multiple insides of houses, one of which was my grandmother's house on my mom's side, but more maze like. I eventually made it to a perfect replica of my grandmother's house on my dad's side, and I saw Bradley S, and someone else I can’t remember there. The last thing I remember is telling them that it was a perfect replica of my grandmother’s house.
thoughts: I like the strange house in this dream. Both the outside and inside were amalgamations, and it really felt huge and maze-like, which I like in a dream. I also wouldn't say maze-like locations are rare in my dreams, but I would put them in the uncommon category, so that bumps this one up a notch. It just felt fun, and traversing the many houses really felt like an expedition.

excerpt: I find a manga that doesn't exist.
title: The Morrigan Manga Dream
content:
I was in a bookstore, looking for something to buy. It looked kind of like my local bookstore at parts, but not really in others. I remember looking for something for a while, and after getting bored of looking, I went to a different part of the store, which had a lot of very tall bookshelves against a wall with a tall curtain on the other side. Because of that, it felt like it was behind a stage, with the curtain being behind me.

It then cut immediately to me, still in the same room, and taking the manga I was going to buy off the shelf. My friend [[James]] was next to me now as well. The manga that I picked up was all about [[Morrigan|Morrigan Aensland]] from [[Darkstalkers]]. The cover was a monotone light minty green and white, and had multiple Morrigans in different outfits in a cutesy art style. The price ($19.99) was also in the bottom right corner. I've made a recreation of it to the best of my ability and memory below. The last thing I remember is telling James about the manga and then us leaving to go pay for it.
thoughts: The manga is the most interesting part of this dream, and is a nice visual. It looked a lot better, and more consistent in the dream, but I'm not an artist, so the image is more of a mock up rather than anything. I also like shopping in my dreams, because that's something that I enjoy in real life when there's at least something I'm into. So, I suppose just grocery shopping isn't my cup of tea, but if the grocery store has DVDs or something, that makes it worth it, even if I don't buy any.

excerpt: I find a Seinfeld DVD at the thrift store.
title: The Thrift Store Seinfeld Dream
content:
I was in an alternate version of my local thrift store, and one that I believe has appeared in my dreams before. I was there looking to buy some DVDs and manga. There was a semi open area with very small two-shelf high shelves on the ground that the DVDs were on, and I could see the book area from there with at least one person browsing.

I was on my knees looking through the DVDs, and the only thing that caught my eye was one of [[Seinfeld]] season 3 (the only other DVD I remember in the DVDs is [[Game of Thrones]], I think). I remember it being [[George|George Costanza]] themed, and since it was the only interesting DVD there, I was pretty excited about finding it. I was also excited because somehow I knew the other seasons were there but got taken. I opened the DVD case, but I saw that the first disc was missing and that’s why it was still there. I was disappointed, so I went over to the manga section where the books were, but it was completely empty.
thoughts:
Before I start with my actual thoughts, I want to mention some interesting facts/things. The first is that, the day that I'm adding this dream to the site, I actually got a complete copy of Seinfeld season 3 on DVD, which is a pretty fun coincidence. The second (and last) is that, although the real Seinfeld season 3 DVD set is not George themed, all of the Seinfeld seasons have 4 discs, each disc is based on a character, and the third disc of every season is actually George themed, which is pretty cool.

In terms of my actual thoughts, thrifting is probably my favourite thing to do when I'm "out." It's kind of like shopping, but from any era with a large element of randomness, which I find extremely fun. So, having a dream about one of my favourite hobbies was cool, even if it didn't end well in the dream.

excerpt: I walk on a boardwalk with a lot of bugs.
title: The Boardwalk Bugs Dream
content:
I was at the same version of the boardwalk from dream [[The Classical Amnesia Dream]], and I was there with my dad. I also think our dog was there as well. I remember there being this one part of the boardwalk that was broken in the middle, and the only walkable part was the short side railings.

There were a bunch of tiny, mosquito-like bugs flying over the hole. My dad was on the other side, and he was trying to get me over to the side he was on. I walked on the railing part as I was trying to swat away the bugs. The railing broke as I walked on it and dipped into the water a little bit. The last thing I remember is my dad reaching for my hand to help me up.
thoughts: I hate bugs. I had a dream where there were bugs. That's probably all I need to say.

excerpt: Someone gets grossed out by me.
title: The Zelda Underwear Dream
content: I remember sitting in front of the entrance to the hallway on the kitchen side of my grandmother's house on my dad's side (shown in the image below), and I was sitting with [[Zelda|Zelda (Breath of the Wild)]] (in her [[Breath of the Wild|The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild]] short haired design). I specifically was sitting diagonally facing the diagonal kitchen cabinets, and Zelda was right across from me. Zelda was teasing me about some stuff that I can’t remember. Later, I was talking to someone, and a pair of black panties (that were from Zelda) fell out of my clothes, and they were grossed out by it, though I don't know how they got there.
thoughts: A strange one, that's for sure. The experience of me sitting on my grandmother's floor is something that appears more than once in my dreams, strangely enough. Zelda in that same design also appears in more than one dream, though as a sequel to this dream. The whole panties things is weird, though, but I suppose it is a dream, and like I mentioned, I don't know how they got there, and there was nothing sexual to this dream.

excerpt: Me, Zelda, a friend, and a YouTuber sit on the floor of my grandparents house.
title: The Zelda Underwear Sequel Dream
content:
In this dream, [[Zelda|Zelda (Breath of the Wild)]] and I were sitting in the same spots as the dream this is a sequel to ([[The Zelda Underwear Dream]]), but now, sitting to the left of Zelda, was the [[YouTuber]] [[SungWon Cho]]. My friend [[James]] was also there, in a way, he was there, but it felt like he was always in the corner of my eye, and I couldn’t quite see him.

Zelda was throwing different colours of panties at me, trying to get a pair in my clothes, for a repeat of the panties incident from the dream this is a sequel to. She also didn’t have a pile of them or anything, she was pulling them out of her sleeves and shirt and whatnot like a magician.

I was dodging all of them, and while that was happening, James, SungWon, and a fifth person (potentially the "fifth" person that I’m about to introduce, but I’m not sure) were just talking amongst themselves. Eventually, a pair of the panties that were on the ground from Zelda throwing them got picked by a fishing rod, with the person using it out of vision. In reaction to this, James said something like "he’s fishing like in Animal Crossing!"

After he said that, instead of the dream being from my POV, it switched to a camera style. The camera was next to SungWon, so it showed the area in front of the bathroom door, revealing the fishing rod person. The fishing rod person was a second SungWon in fishing attire and parading around his fishing rod with the panties on it (I think these ones were pink, but I’m not sure). It then cut back to my POV, and all of us talked for a second about the fishing SungWon before it cut once again to the camera angle. The last thing I remember is James (who was still permanently in the corner of my eye) getting mad at the fishing SungWon.
thoughts: A strange sequel to a strange dream. To be perfectly honest, the concept of a sequel dream is kind of up in the air. Dreams aren't necessarily in a vacuum, but maybe it would be more apt to say this is a dream about another dream, with some extra parts added on. But, functionally, this works as a sequel to that previous dream. Regardless, the different camera angles is always something interesting for a dream, and my friend always being in the corner of my eyes is something that's yet to happen in a dream again (so far). Zelda in her Breath of the Wild short hair design is one of my favourite character designs, and characters, so it was also cool to see her in a dream again. She was trying to get me in trouble, but it was kind of in a playful way in the dream.

excerpt: I meet a character from the sitcom Modern Family probably.
title: The Bathtub Dream
content:
I was in the bathtub at my grandparents house on my dad's side with the curtain opened. I was talking to [[Haley Dunphy]] from [[Modern Family]] (at least I think it was her. If it wasn’t, it was that genre of woman, so to speak), and we were having a pretty casual conversation.

I didn’t really understand why she was so comfortable with me being naked, even if I was in the bathtub. I realized why because when I got up, I was wearing shorts in the tub. It then cut to a different scene right as I was standing up. The scene was me and her walking through the hallway past the bedrooms from a side angle. When we walked in front of my brother’s bedroom, it ended.
thoughts: Standard strange dream fair if you ask me. I don't think I was watching a lot of Modern Family at the time I had this dream, but I had just finished watching a lot of it, so that makes sense, I suppose. Especially when you consider that it only might be a character from that show, not for certain. Water in dreams has also never really been an issue for me. Many people associate it with... Physical danger, and I did for a time, but I've had many dreams involving water and the like, but it has never been an issue for me... Knock on wood.

excerpt: I go to an ice rink with my friends.
title: The Ice Rink Dream
content:
I was in a weird open parking lot area, with the pavement to my left at a slight decline. It was a cold and overcast day, and there was a small, almost shed-like building to my left. I knew that it was a building in relation to the school, and I thought the whole purpose of it was to get snacks. So, since I didn't have a class, I went in.

I waited in line for the snacks, and as I was waiting, my friend [[Nina]] joined the line as well. When it finally got to my turn, the principal was the one at the counter, and I had to sign a form. She also knew me by name, which surprised me. It turned out that the snacks were just complementary, and I just signed up for a volunteer thing at an ice rink (nothing about it in the dream involves volunteering, but that’s just how it felt).

The dream then cut to me, Nina, [[Pamela]], and [[James]] at the ice rink. It was small and indoors, and there were some piles of snow at various spots on the edge of it. James leaned up against a wall, and I think Pamela and Nina already had their skates because they went off somewhere. For some reason, the place where you get the skates was across the ice, so I slid across the ice in my shoes and got some skates. They also had lessons, and the last thing I remember is taking part in said lessons.
thoughts: I've been ice skating twice in my entire life, and I didn't really enjoy it either time. I'm not a person who can balance very well, so that's probably why. So, I find it a bit strange that I had a dream about an ice rink. Then again, it is an experience I've had before, so that makes it fair game for a dream, I suppose. I don't really have much else to say on this one, to be honest.

excerpt: I get in a fight with someone from my math class.
title: The Math Guy Dream
content: I was in a fight with a guy from my math class for some reason. And let me tell you, this was a built guy. I'm not sure if he played football, but he looked exactly like the type of huge football player you would see in media. I was trying to fight him, but then he got me in a reverse bear hug, and I was screaming because it hurt. I was screaming more than the pain was worth, but it hurt nonetheless. At this point, my dad (who was there for some reason) socked him in the face, freeing me. That’s all I can remember.
thoughts: I'm not the type of person to get into a fight, so that sort of thing doesn't appeal to me, especially in a dream (it doesn't help that I was losing, haha). A big anime style fight? Sure. But something like this, not so much. I've also never been in a real fight before, so who knows, maybe I would enjoy it? Getting pummeled by some guy over something stupid... Sounds great!

excerpt: I go on a field trip to the mall.
title: The Mall Field Trip Dream
content:
I’ve had various dreams under this umbrella that I’m about to describe, but since they all have melded together, and I don’t know what’s separate, they will be counted as one dream. I was in my local mall, and it was completely empty except for the teachers and students of my middle school, and we were there because it was a field trip.

I remember going up an escalator alone, and at the top, I saw [[my English teacher|Ms. Middle School English]], so I said hi before leaving to go check out some of the stores. I only remember going to two stores. The first was a food store which was in basically a halved version of the food court (which is fairly small as is), and I think I wanted to buy something but didn’t have the money. I also remember seeing [[Bradley S.]] and [[Shauna]] there as well, the only other people I actually saw other than shop owners and one other person to be mentioned.

The other shop I went to was a kind of retro store, and the inside reminded me of a candy store. I got really excited and disappointed because they had 4 or 5 packs of the [[Pokémon]] card set [[Neo Genesis]] for about 2 bucks each (which is good as is, but it's a retro set, so packs go for hundreds), but I didn’t have any money. The last thing I can remember is me leaving that shop and telling my friend [[Pamela]] about it.
thoughts: Field trips are absolutely wonderful, and I figure the average person probably doesn't have their number of field trips go into the double digits, so having a dream about a field trip is pretty cool. I also got the experience of shopping around, even if I didn't have any money in the dream haha. The mall being mostly empty was pretty cool as well, and it kind of felt like a liminal space, as many real life locations do in dreams.

excerpt: I go to a beach.
title: The Beach Dream
content: This is kind of a meld of different dreams that I’ve had but can’t separate in my mind. I was at an actual beach, but it looked kind of like local lake, and there was a big rock in the sand. The sand was more wet than normal, almost like quick sand. I remember going to the water, and I was able to go really far without the water being too high. The day was overcast, so there were only a few people in the water, and the last thing that I can remember is a wave coming in.
thoughts: Going to the beach/lake is probably the only Summer exclusive activity that I enjoy, and that's because I don't do well in the heat. So, having a dream about it is only natural. Too bad that's all there is to this one, just beach and wet. I like beach and wet, but I can go to beach and wet during one quarter of the year, that's enough for me.

excerpt: I hang out in my elementary school library.
title: The Elementary School Library Dream
content:
As are some of my dreams, this is a collection of dreams that have melded together over the years, so I'm collecting them under one dream. I was in the library at my elementary school looking for something to read. I was in the section with the bins of books (shown in the layout image below), looking for something to read. I then went to the other part and I remember seeing all of the [[Diary of a Wimpy Kid]] books plus some that didn’t exist. Around the same area there was also anime as well.

In one of the dreams, the shelf at the back had a bunch of [[Amulet]] series books, cookbooks and I think other sci-fi books and magazines. In another dream, I was going there because there were a bunch of comic books on that shelf, but right as I got there, a janitor took them away to throw them out. I was going to ask if I could have them, but I was too scared.
thoughts: For some reason, I've had a lot of dreams at my elementary school library. It just started out as something weird, but then it developed into me thinking about it being weird, so it happened a lot more. I probably have a dozen or so that take place in that location in one way or another. This is one of the less interesting ones of the bunch, but I think it's still kind of up there. It's just kind of hard to compare when I've had better dreams in the same location.

excerpt: I'm at my grandmother's house at night.
title: The Night Time Grammie’s House Dream
content: In this dream, I was in my brother's room (the middle bedroom in the layout image) at my grandmother's house on my dad’s side, and it was around 12 or 1 in the morning. Time felt weird, like it was in the middle of time going forward or backward. I could hear my grandmother and my dad talking, so I opened the door to see what was going on. I don’t think I was supposed to hear because they stopped when I came out.
thoughts: My grandmother's house is a place that appears in my dreams very often, since as you can imagine, I have a lot of memories there. Unless I'm getting up in the middle of the night to use the washroom, the 12 to 1 area of time is an unknown zone there, so it was interesting to have a dream about that period of time. I didn't really like that a secret was being kept from me, though, and other than that, that's all this dream was, so it could have been better.

excerpt: I play a weird version of Super Mario 64.
title: The Mario 64 Dream
content:
I was playing [[Super Mario 64]], and the perspective was as if it were recorded with a [[capture card]]. I was in a level that didn’t exist. The level was very tall, and [[Mario]] dropped into it, falling from the ceiling. There were different ledges and outcroppings for Mario to fall onto, and at the bottom of the level there was water.

I remember two points, one was when I fell onto an outcropping and followed it into a room with a puzzle that I couldn’t figure out. There other was me getting Mario to fall all the way to the bottom in the water and swimming into a section that took me to [[Peach’s castle]].
thoughts: Super Mario 64 is one of my favourite games of all time, so you already know how I feel having a dream about it, especially so since I was playing a new level. Who needs rom hacks when you have your own brain, right? I don't know what else to say, even with me enjoying this dream so much. I just enjoy games, you know?

excerpt: I play a weird version of Donkey Kong 64.
title: The Donkey Kong 64 Dream
content: This dream took place in the same area and was the same kind of deal as [[The Mario 64 Dream]], except it was [[Donkey Kong 64]] instead of [[Super Mario 64]]. I was playing as [[Donkey Kong]], and I was on a ledge and I did a [[Simian Slam]] to get a star. I was talking to someone, and I remember saying to them that it was a stupid idea to add stars to DK64 because of how many [[golden bananas|Golden Banana]] were already in the game.
thoughts: Just like the dream this is a pseudo sequel to (The Mario 64 Dream), I enjoyed this one because it involved me playing a game I really like. It was also a cool dream to be a sequel. And even though I like DK64 less than SM64, this dream is about as high up for the idea, and the gameplay was pretty cool, too.

excerpt: Me and some friends find a diamond.
title: The Victor And Daniel Diamond Dream
content: In this dream, me and my friends [[Victor]], and [[Daniel]] were at my grandmother's house on my dad's side. We were running through the hallway to get to the cabinet in front of the bathroom (shown in the layout image). When we got there, the three of us got a diamond that fell off of something that was on top of the cabinet.
thoughts: Nothing crazy here, but I wouldn't mind if this one happened in real life; I could use the extra money, haha. Even though this is a small thing, I enjoy running in dreams since there no physical limitations. It's how I imagine Sonic The Hedgehog feels.

excerpt: My grandmother's house becomes an RPG.
title: The RPG Shop Dream
content: I was at my grandmother's house on my dad's side and things were weird. It was like an RPG and each room was a different part of the map. I started at my brother’s room (the middle room in the layout image), which was a standard fantasy RPG (magic swords, cloaks, that sort of thing) kind of shop. I had to do something in each room to get to the next, and the hallway was like a map screen. The last thing I remember is me as an RPG map icon over my room (basically, a small pixel art version of me).
thoughts:
It's hard for me to explain, but I've had a lot of "daydreams" like this. First of all, "daydreams" is in quotes because they actually happen when I'm trying to fall asleep, and I have my eyes closed, picturing things in my head. I would have a story idea, and I would run though it in my head, and sometimes I would be so tired I would picture it in the context of something else.

For example, I would have two characters talking, but it would be pictured in my head using, say, the visuals of Super Mario World if I had played it that day. That's kind of how this dream was, but more connected, and in dream form instead of "daydream" form. Now, if that makes sense, good. If it doesn't, well, I don't blame you.

excerpt: I'm at a weird version of my local mall.
title: The Weird Mall Dream
content:
I was in a weird version of my local mall that had a large open area that was breezeway-like, and yellow on the second floor (you'll see the layout in the layout image). I went into that part, and it led to an area with multiple stores in a semicircle but square configuration. I know my dad was there, but we were each doing our own thing.

In one of the corner parts there was a [[Thomas Wooden Railway]] play table. In one of the hallways there was a bakery built into the wall, and I think I got a cookie from it. I left the square semicircle and went to a store that was there right when I left. It was a weird jewellery store that had everything hanging on hooks. There were also plants and I think anime cards in the store. The last thing I remember is walking around it a bit.
thoughts: This is a dream I had a very long time ago, way back when I was a kid. Naturally, these dreams are a dying breed, so it's always cool to remember a dream when I was a kid. The weird layout of this one and the vibes were cool as well. And hey, who doesn't like a dream where you get a cookie? In fact, along with that and the train table, this is a pretty childish dream. You could probably tell I had this one when I was a kid if I didn't tell you.

excerpt: I go to a weird grocery store.
title: The Weird Grocery Store Dream
content: I was in this weird grocery store that was huge and very maze-like. There were shelves everywhere, and I was trying to escape, but I just couldn’t. It felt like a nightmare in that aspect, but it wasn’t scary like one. The last thing I remember is that I’ve had this dream many multiple times.
thoughts: This is another dream that I had when I was a kid, but even with me having many more dreams since, this is probably the most recurring dream I've had. I haven't had it recently at all, so it was only when I was a kid, but I probably had it a double digit amount of times back then. It's super weird to me now, because although I've had dreams I would consider as follow ups or sequels, but I've never had dreams that were the exact same since I was a kid. It was also one of the few dreams were I tried to escape it, which are a type of dream I only had as a kid as well.

excerpt: I go to a weird game store with 3DS games.
title: The Weird Game Store Dream
content: I was in this weird version of my local [[EB Games]], and I was looking through the games. There were a bunch of [[3DS]] games, and there were some pretty good deals, but I didn’t have any money. There were also some retro games as well but only three of them. The layout was also different. The cash register was in the corner on a diagonal, and there were multiple shelves in the middle of the store, but the one I was looking at was against a wall. One of the games I remember being there was [[Kid Icarus Uprising]], and I also think my dad was there.
thoughts: I love me some video games, and this is a dream about video games. Crazy stuff. There's also no layout for this one, because although I did describe it, many of these dreams I have written down a while ago, so I don't really remember it in detail, and didn't describe it well enough for me to really get a good idea. It's not a big deal, anyway. Shopping for games in a dream is always pretty cool, though, even if this one is pretty simple.

excerpt: I hang out with two of my friends.
title: The Hanging With Friends Dream
content:
This dream starts out with me and my friend [[James]] at my grandmother's house on my dad's side, standing in the living room right before we were going to leave for home. We were talking about something, but I can’t remember what. It then cut to the next scene where we were at my house, and I was saying goodbye to James because he was going back home.

Then, my mom told me that my other friend [[Pamela]] called, so I called her back, and she asked if I wanted to come over. It then cut again to me at her house in the basement, I think. It cut one last time to me back home, and I was mulling over the fact that I did two things on a Sunday.
thoughts: As someone who doesn't go out too much, going out twice in one day kind of takes a lot out of me, especially when I have something I need to do the next day, even if it's with people I enjoy hanging out with. As a result, the best way I can describe this dream is that I mind it, if that makes sense. People often say they don't mind something, but I mind this one just a little bit. It's not a large mind, just a small one, but still a mind.

excerpt: I download games from Steam.
title: The Steam Games Dream
content: All I remember from this dream is getting a bunch of games on [[Steam]] and downloading them. I was staring at my computer while a small Steam window was on it with number/number games downloaded, and a progress bar as well as the icon of the game currently downloading next to it, all in the window.
thoughts: The feeling of getting a bunch of games on Steam (presumably for free) was pretty cool, and actually, I once won a draw where I got the World End Economica trilogy on Steam for free, so this dream was kind of like that. It's a pretty good feeling getting things for free on occasion, and so a dream capturing that feeling was simple, but nice.

excerpt: I look around my community centre.
title: The Community Centre Library Dream
content: I was talking to the person at the counter at my local community centre about something, and then went to the library. I remember just looking around, and the layout was slightly different. Then, I went to the other side of the community centre to the room with the [[Wii|Nintendo Wii]] in it (the club room on the left side), and just peeked my head in, but didn’t actually go in. The last thing I remember is going into the boy's bathroom.
thoughts: My local community centre is an occasional dream location, which is pretty impressive since I haven't been there in ages, and the last time I wanted to go there, it was closed because of water damage, and has been for some time (I'm starting to wonder if it'll ever be reopened). So, since I currently couldn't go there if I tired, this dream was a pleasant reminder of the place I spent a lot of time in as a kid.

excerpt: A go to the music room at my elementary school.
title: The Music Room Dream
content:
I was a my elementary school, and I was wandering around the halls. I remember having to go through this small, tight space, which led me to stairs that were similar to the ones that led to the dentist area (basically, only a few steps, not going down/up to a separate floor, and in the corner of the building). I went up them, and they led me to the weird grey pre-primary area (the hallways were grey, there were barely any windows, and barely any lights), and there was light emanating from one of the rooms.

I stayed out in the hallway for a bit, and I’m foggy on this part, but I remember playing a sport, finding something important, and [[Bradley S.]] was there, and this all happened in the hallway. Eventually, I went into the room, and it was a weird version of the music room that was all grey and a slightly different layout. Only a few other kids were there, and the last thing I remember is the music teacher trying to teach us how to play something.
thoughts: I'm not sure if I had this dream when I was in elementary school, but I definitely had it a long time ago, and when I was in early middle school at the latest. So, this is another one of a kind, "classic dream" of which there are more than one, haha. Anyway, the area described in the dream always had a weird vibe back then, so it had extra weird vibes in dream form, which is pretty cool. The weirder the vibes in real life, the even weirder vibes in dreams.

excerpt: I'm at my grandmother's house when she's not there.
title: The Grammie At Work Dream
content: My whole family was at my grandmother's house on my dad's side because we were watching it while she was at work. It was a very weird experience because of how very few times I have been there when she wasn’t. The last thing I remember is me laying down on the floor in the hallway at around five o'clock while the sun was setting, and then her suddenly appearing from the kitchen.
thoughts: A dream that I don't have much to say on. It had a weird vibe to it since it was something that normally doesn't happen, but that would be the same case for real life. So yeah, strange dream, strange vibe, strange reality.

excerpt: I go to read Shonen Jump.
title: The Shonen Jump Mat Dream
content:
I was laying down on my parent's bed, and my mom and one of my brother’s old friends were laying down too. I wanted to go and read [[Shonen Jump]], and when I went to leave to go to my room, it was a completely different area. It was a room with a bunch of shelves of Shonen Jump and a bed.

There was a TV at the side of the bed, and I had to go behind it, past all the cords, to leave the room. I went back there and down a set of stairs which led to [[Pamela]]'s house, but the only person there was [[Mat]]. I returned to the bed after going through the weird shelf TV area and laid back down.
thoughts: A dream with a location that makes absolutely makes no sense is a good dream. I love the weird dream locations, and I love Shonen Jump, so this is a wonderful marriage of two very specific things. It's also nice when my friends appear in my dreams, and it's funny because they always act like they do in real life for the most part. In fact, most real people in my dreams act like they do normally, which I wonder if that's the case for everyone.

excerpt: I make a Thomas layout.
title: The Thomas Wooden Railway Dream
content: I was in my room, looking through my toy box of [[Thomas The Tank Engine|Thomas & Friends]] stuff, specifically wanting to get out my [[Thomas Wooden Railway]] stuff. I was looking for specific pieces so I could make an oval layout on my table, and I was putting trains and whatnot on it. I can’t remember if I had my stuff still on the table or not, but I don’t think so.
thoughts: I think this is a later dream, basically being at the point where I was (and I suppose, still am) nostalgic for Thomas as opposed to me being a kid and it being one of the only things I cared about. In fact, this might be the first dream I had since I got nostalgic for it, but it still happened well after I was involved with Thomas. Also, cool table, right? Not so cool DVD, though. I've been watching though all my DVDs, and Two And A Half Men is alright, not great, not bad... Not relevant, really.

excerpt: I make a Thomas layout at my grandparents house.
title: The Thomas Wooden Railway Sequel Dream
content: To start with, I consider this dream a sequel to [[The Thomas Wooden Railway Dream]]. I was at my grandmother's house on my dad's side looking through the drawers in my train table because I was trying to make the perfect layout on it. I remember making some bridges, a siding, and placing some trains on there as well.
thoughts: I don't really know if I would consider this dream a sequel to the previous one nowadays, but I did when I originally wrote down this dream, and other than names of my friends, I don't change these dreams when I put them on this website. This dream did kind of did feel like a sequel vibe wise, almost like an alternate version of the previous, just at a different location. The table in the image also isn't the exact same as the one I had as a kid, but it's pretty similar.

excerpt: I watch The Simpsons Movie on DVD.
title: The Simpsons Movie Dream
