content: I was watching my DVD of [[The Simpsons Movie]], and I think that I got it around the time I had this dream. I also think I was watching it on my DVD player, but I can’t remember for sure. Another thing is that I think I was watching that one deleted scene with the cut sidekick character to the president, but I can’t say for sure.
thoughts: Collecting DVDs and VHS tapes is one of my favourite hobbies, so even a pretty simple dream of me watching one of the DVDs I got was pretty nice. Especially so since this is when I first started collecting DVDs specifically. It's a nice dream that reminds me of a nice memory.

excerpt: I look through my toy box.
title: The Thomas Toy Box Dream
content: I was at my grandmother's house on my dad's side and looking through my toy box of [[Thomas|Thomas & Friends]] stuff. I was looking for specific characters, but I couldn’t find specific ones because I had a separate toy box at home with the other half of my stuff. Then, there was a separate part of the dream where it was in the reverse, and I was looking through the one at home. Also, this isn't accurate to real life, since I didn't have a toy box at my grandmother's house back in the day.
thoughts: Another classic nostalgic dream, and naturally, it includes Thomas, because that was my life as a kid. I have many memories of looking though my toy box, and trying to find something specific, only for it to all the way at the bottom. So, this dream kind of captures that feeling, and just the nostalgia of toys in general.

excerpt: I talk with one of my friends.
title: The Nina Talking Dream
content: I was sitting at a table with my friend [[Nina]], and it was just us having a casual conversation. We were talking about her some characters she created, and discussing something we could do together like either go to the store, the beach, or something like that, and I remember us picking the specific date of July 21st.
thoughts: To me, the strangest part of this dream is that I remembered the specific date. Small details are something that are hard for me to remember in dreams, so I truly am surprised that I was able to remember that date. Also, other than one of my friends, I'm typically with my friends as a group, so although nice, it was a little weird being alone with Nina.

excerpt: I filter through some papers.
title: The Papers Dream
content: I was sorting out some loose drawings in front of my TV (my old thinner widescreen TV as opposed to the chunkier one you can partially see in the image). I can’t remember any of the specific drawings I was sorting through other than the fact that they were all loose ones, and not part of a sketchbook.
thoughts: This is something I would on occasion when I would draw. I still draw sometimes, but it's something I really have to be in the mood for, and it's something I just do for fun. So when I would draw on loose paper instead of a sketchbook, I would put everything into a big folder, and since I put that folder in the cabinet my TV is on, I'd put things away in front of my TV. All that said, this is a boring dream because that's what I did/still sometimes do in real life.

excerpt: I lose my college password.
title: The College Password Dream
content: In this dream, it was me calling my college to get my password for either my account for my finances or my main account (which I either just did or needed to do in real life, and it was for my main account in real life), and I was very nervous about it. I also remember doing it multiple times, almost as if I had separate dreams, but I’m pretty sure it was just one dream.
thoughts: This was not a fun dream since, at the time, the real call I had to make about this made me really nervous. I'm not good with people, especially over the phone, but it was really bad back then. In fact, this may be the only dream where I've been so nervous in real life that it leaked into my dreams. I've had much worse experiences before and since, so I think this was a sweet spot in terms of the subject of the dream being nerveracking, but not too nerveracking.

excerpt: I find nostalgic items at my grandmother's house.
title: The Nostalgic Items Dream
content: I was at my grandmother's house on my dad's side in my room. There was a dresser that used to be there, and a separate set of drawers where the night stand is (shown in the layout image). I was sitting on the floor and looking through the drawers, and I was finding a bunch of stuff. I remember finding some [[Mario]] plushies, but the only one I can specifically remember is a green [[Yoshi]]. I also found some [[Thomas|Thomas & Friends]] stuff, some Mario figures, and a bunch of other things that I can’t remember in detail.
thoughts: Dreams plus nostalgia is always a great feeling. I do have a lot of Mario plushies and figures in real life (I even do have a green Yoshi, but I can't remember if it's the same as the one from my dream), most of them being from my childhood, but I remember many of the ones from this dream being ones I didn't have. It also had a little bit of a weird vibe, because other than some Thomas Wooden Railway stuff, most of my toys and such were at home, so I would bring them to my grandparents when I went, and brought them back home with me when I went home. So, it felt weird, but nice since it felt like a treasure trove of toys that I had completely forgotten about.

excerpt: I sit on a trap door.
title: The Trap Door Dream
content: I was sitting in the same spot as dream [[The Nostalgic Items Dream]] (also shown in the layout image), except the spot I was sitting on was a drawer in the floor, basically a trap door. I remember that I already looked in the dresser in front of me and the drawers to the left of me. Somehow I was looking through the trap door as I was on top of it.
thoughts: There's not a lot to this dream, but what there is to it is something I really like in dreams, and that's locations/visuals that don't make any sense. In this case, it's me seeing something that I shouldn't be able to see at all. Most of my dreams are either POVs or set at specific "camera angles," but this may be the only dream I've had we're it's a POV that makes no sense at all.

excerpt: I find some copies at Shonen Jump at my grandmother's house.
title: The Shonen Jump At Grammie’s Dream
content: I was at my grandmother's house on my dad's side in my brother's room. I was just chilling, and the closet was open. I looked in it, and there were many different volumes of [[Shonen Jump]] lining the shelves, as well as some anime DVDs. I started taking the volumes that I didn’t have as well as the anime DVDs.
thoughts: This is another dream where I get cool things that I would want in real life. I have a lot of copies of Shonen Jump in real life, but like mentioned in the dream, I was taking copies I didn't already have. Same thing with the anime DVDs, except I have much less of those. It's just really nice to get a bunch of things without having to worry about money.

excerpt: I find some video games at my grandmother's house.
title: The Video Game Closet Dream
content: I was at my grandmother's house on my dad's side in my brother's room, and it was the same situation as [[The Shonen Jump At Grammie’s Dream]], except the closet was full of video games. There were a bunch of [[GameCube|Nintendo GameCube]] games in the closet, and I started taking some of the ones that I didn’t have.
thoughts: This is the same situation as the dream mentioned, and so I feel the same way about it since video games, manga, and anime fill a similar role in my realm of hobbies. Not much else to say since I pretty much covered in the other dream.

excerpt: I go out to buy some DVDs.
title: The Buying DVDs Dream
content: This one is very simple. In this dream, it was me at my local thrift store, looking for some DVDs to buy. As far as I can remember, it was just the normal version of the thrift store, not any of the weird iterations I’ve seen in my previous dreams. I also can’t remember any specific DVDs, just the fact that I was looking for some.
thoughts: Another dream about me doing one of my hobbies in real life. Naturally, it's enjoyable, but to me, it's extra enjoyable since my local thrift store that was close to me closed, so now I have to take a bus if I even want to go. I had this dream before then, but it's still nice that I can look back on this dream.

excerpt: I find some Pokémon stickers.
title: The Pokémon Stickers Dream
content: I remember standing in front of a table and there were stickers of the cards from the [[Pokémon Southern Islands]] card set for some reason. There were also multiple deck boxes of cards from the [[Pokémon Jungle]] card set, and I remember picking up three of them, two in my left hand and one in my right hand.
thoughts: It's a little odd that the Pokémon cards in this dream were stickers, but I think there are actual Pokémon card stickers. If I recall correctly, there were Ditto Pokémon cards that had stickers of different Pokémon cards over them as a little gimmick. I just don't know if I knew about that before I had this dream. But, of course, it doesn't matter, because you can make pretty much anything up in a dream.

excerpt: I go shopping for Pokémon cards.
title: The Lapras Card Dream
content: I was at a [[Pokémon]] card shop, and I went up to the counter to ask the person what strong cards he had. He showed me a [[Lapras]] card which had two attacks. I don’t know anything about the first one other than it cost two [[colourless energy]]. The second attack only cost one [[water energy]], and did 60 damage with no repercussions. I was going to get it, but the guy told me that it was 14 dollars, so I turned around and went to look through my own cards first to see if I already had any strong cards.
thoughts: To me, a 14 dollar Pokémon card is absolutely crazy. Of course, there are cards worth way, way, way more, but I wouldn't buy a card worth more than a pack personally. I'm also a bit surprised that I remembered the details I did about the card, since details come a little harder to remember in dreams. It was a pretty cool dream, though.

excerpt: I fight Ciel from Tsukihime.
title: The Ciel Senpai Dream
content:
I was in a [[Go parlour]], specifically from the manga [[Hikaru No Go]], and I was the main character. [[Ciel]] from [[Tsukihime]] (who was specifically in her church outfit) had to kill me, and as she was about to do so with her big gun (shown in the image below), it switched to her perspective. Ciel could see "inside" of me, with her vision basically being like a thermal camera but blue, and instead of seeing heat, she could see souls, which were a lighter blue. The reason she had to kill me was because I had multiple souls inside of me, and to her that meant that I ate them. In actuality, the reason I had multiple was because I was a good person.

The scene then did a slow zoom out as Ciel was about to do me in. At the same time, I did narration about how I had a good time with Ciel before and things weren’t supposed to end the way they did. It then flashed back to a scene with a side camera angle of Ciel in a pink two piece bikini, coming from the left on a boogie board, and somehow riding it on the sidewalk.

I then came out of a portal, and was riding a boogie board right alongside her. After that, it cut to us at the beach from my first-person perspective as we both did slides to the side, kicking up sand in the process. It then cut one last time to both of us in the water, splashing about. For some reason, Ciel (who was slightly tanned at this point) wanted me to lift her up while we were in the water.
thoughts: This is a top tier dream. The only reason it's not a 10 out of 10 is because I've had a similar dream after this one that was so good that it inspired me to write a story. You can't really get better than that, but this one was still great. Ciel is one of my favourite characters, and so having to fight her was really cool. This dream really just felt like a movie, and I love movies. It had action, it had drama, and it had a really weird backstory, what more could you want?

excerpt: A girl sings a song.
title: The Expelled Song Dream
content: I remember me hearing a song using the word "expelled." It was sung in a young girl's voice, so it was very childish in nature and "expelled" was the only word. There was also no actual music, it was just sung to a rough tune made up by the girl. I don’t think there were any actual visual aspects to this dream, either.
thoughts: Strange indeed. Music in general in dreams is strange, so having a random girl with no visuals singing a song using one word was very, very odd. It was odd in the good dream way, though.

excerpt: A have soap on me when I'm out of the shower.
title: The Soap Outside Of The Shower Dream
content: I was just getting out of the shower, and I went in front of the sink to get a towel. When I was in front of the sink, I remembered that I didn’t use any soap in the shower, so I grabbed some that was on the sink and started rubbing it on my arms.
thoughts: This is a dream I would put in the graveyard now considering how little there is to it, but hey, I didn't when I first wrote it down, so here it is. It's kind of weird that I would do this, and if I for some reason did go in the shower and didn't use soap, I would either hop back in the shower, or wait until my next shower if I didn't smell bad.

excerpt: I look for something in my bag.
title: The Pokémon Red Dream
content: In this dream, I was looking through my backpack. I knew that I had my [[GBA|Game Boy Advance]] case in there before, but it wasn’t in there anymore. When I was searching for whatever I was searching for, I saw my copy of [[Pokémon Red]] at the bottom, and I knew I had to take it out, but whatever I was looking for was more important.
thoughts: To me, the strange part of this dream is that I knew certain information (like about my GBA case), and also how I was looking for something important. I wrote it with such conviction that it sounds really important, but I don't think it was as important as I made it sound. I was just looking for something and that's it.

excerpt: I find Ace Attorney games at a thrift store.
title: The Ace Attorney Thrift Store Dream
content:
I was at a weird thrift store. It had large shelves, and part of the floors were carpeted. I was looking at the bottom part of one of the shelves, and I found three [[Ace Attorney|Ace Attorney (Series)]] DS games. One was just the original trilogy, but on one cartridge and with the requirement that you had to play the games in order. So, right after you beat the last case of the first game, it would take you straight to the first of the second and so on.

The second game was just an alternate version of [[Apollo Justice: Ace Attorney]]. The third was a [[rom hack]] that I don’t remember anything else about. I was going to buy all three, but I didn’t have enough money, so I bought one of them with the intent of coming back later to buy the rest.
thoughts: A classic games and shopping dream (I have the tags for a reason, haha). Of course, both are things that I like, so it makes sense to have dreams about them. These types of dreams would be honestly top tier if I didn't have so many of them. Still in a high tier of dreams.

excerpt: I hold a flintlock pistol.
title: The Flintlock Pistol Dream
content: In this dream, I had a flintlock pistol, and I was holding the same way as [[Sanji]] did when [[Nico Robin]] (known as Ms. All Sunday at the time) showed up on their ship for the first time. I don’t think it was that actual scene from the show, that’s just the best way I can describe it.
thoughts: Really not a lot to say on this one. I was just holding a flintlock pistol for some reason... Yep, that's it.

excerpt: I find some manga in a near empty room.
title: The Empty Room Manga Dream
content: I remember being in this very weird house that had a pretty short roof, a carpeted floor, a recliner, and a shop counter. I also knew that I was on the second floor. I left the room and I went into a different room, which was almost completely empty except for a big shelf against the wall I was facing. The last thing I remember is on the top middle, seeing almost all of the [[Legend of Zelda manga|The Legend of Zelda (Manga)]] there.
thoughts: I like strange locations in my dreams, and I feel as though houses are some of the more uncommon dream original locations. Most of the time it's shops or something like that, so to get a house is nice, even if I don't really remember what it looked like now other than what I wrote down. I also actually have some (but not all) of the Legend of Zelda manga.

excerpt: I watch a Moist Critical video.
title: The Moist Critical Dream
content: was laying down on my parent's bed, facing towards the door. I was watching a [[Moist Critical]] video on a laptop right in front of me. The video was Charlie talking about porn addiction, and I was drifting in and out of sleep as I was watching the video.
thoughts: To me, the most interesting part of this dream is the fact that I was falling in and out of sleep. That's a weird thing to happen in a dream, though I didn't actually fall asleep. I don't think I've ever fallen asleep in a dream, I've only ever woken up. So, I wonder what happens if you fall asleep in a dream.

excerpt: I lay down on my parents bed.
title: The Laying Down Dream
content: I was laying down on one half of my parent's bed with my mother laying on the other half, and that’s it. The vibes were kind of similar to a few other dreams that took place in my parent's room. In fact, I’d say most dreams that take place there have a similar vibe, that being just slightly off from real life.
thoughts: I can't say a lot about this dream since it's just one thing, but the slightly odd vibes from real life were cool. If only I could describe a vibe perfectly on this website. My 4D isn't smell-o-vision, it's vibe-o-vision.

excerpt: I write down some dreams.
title: The Writing Down Dreams Dream
content: I woke up from having [[The Moist Critical Dream]] and [[The Laying Down Dream]], and I went to write them down on my phone to remember for later. Every time I opened the notes app on my phone, and was about to write them down, I woke up again to realize that what I was about to do was also a dream. This happened at least three times before I woke up for real.
thoughts: Realizing you're in a dream only to "wake up" or have something change is something that I find neat, and absolutely terrifying. This is because what is stopping that from happening for a long time? From what I've researched, the average person dreams for about 3 hours a night (though, obviously it varies), and dreams feel longer than they are, so it could feel like many hours of that, and that just sounds horrible.

excerpt: I go to school during the Summer.
title: The Summer School Dream
content: This is a fusion of multiple dreams that have all blended together over the years. Basically it is just me enjoying my Summer, and then halfway through July or something like that, there’s just one day of school and that’s basically it. Also, I've had dreams in this vein after this one that I have remembered.
thoughts: As horrifying as this dream amalgam of dreams sounds to some, I just remember being annoyed that my Summer was getting interrupted more than anything. That's not that surprising to me now, because I imagine that's how I would feel if I was still going though my education, but in this case, I am a little surprised since I had these dreams when I was still in school, and Summer was everything.

excerpt: I go to a store run by my high school.
title: The School Movie Store Dream
content:
I was in a small, one room sized movie store that was run by my high school. There were shelves built into the walls, with two normal shelves in the middle with space between them, and a counter in the left corner which was across from the entrance (this is all shown in the layout image).

I was looking around with my friend [[James]] as we were both trying to find some movies to buy. We were both walking around and looking for a while, but then we both found the anime section. We were looking at both the VHS tapes and DVDs they had in said section, and I remember James having some movies, but I don’t know if he got them from the anime section or elsewhere.

I ended up seeing a few of the [[Dragon Ball Z]] movies on VHS, some very unnerving horror stuff that I can’t quite remember that was on DVD, and the sequel DVD to my real life DVD of [[Soar High! Isami]]. I also saw some blank tapes that were on their length instead of height and facing forward (basically, facing to be displayed).

I got two of the Dragon Ball Z movies and debated on getting Soar High! Isami, but didn’t. The first Dragon Ball Z movie that I got was in a completely black clip shut style of case with no logos or anything on it. The second was in a red clip shut style case (there's an image of what I mean in the gallery), except it had a cover that was just [[Trunks]] as a [[Super Saiyan]] in front of a background (I've made a mock up of this).

As I was picking up my movies, I remember telling James about the difference between the [[Dragon Ball|Dragon Ball (Anime)]] movies and the Dragon Ball Z movies. We went to the line after that, and for some reason there were piles of clothes everywhere around it. We entered the line and accidentally butted in front of people, so we went back in the line and accidentally butted in front of people again, but this time it was someone from my English class and one of her friends. She was really upset and ran out of the store, so I gave James some money and my movies and asked him to pay on my behalf. I ran after her, and when I left the store, I came out in front of my grandmother's bedroom on my dad's side (the top room).
thoughts: This is quite the beefy one, though probably not the longest dream I've written down. Funny story though, this dream is actually more based in reality than you might think. When I was in high school, my school did actually run a thrift store like store for a few days, but either nobody cared, or they didn't advertize it enough since they had a day where everything was one dollar, and then free. My friends and I only went on the free day, and I ended up getting a CD player, so it was worth it. The dream was pretty cool too, and it even had a slight creepy aspect to it with the horror movies, which I remember being scary in the dream nightmare kind of way.

excerpt: I meet some friends at a bar.
title: The Bar Dream
content:
I was at this weird bar in my local city, and I was sitting at the bar counter, though I don't know why I was there in the first place. I was just chilling, but I looked behind me to see a round table with [[Sam|Sam (Female)]] (someone I once knew) sitting at it. She looked the same as always, except she was wearing a pair of glasses and looked a little older.

I got up to talk to her, and we ended up engaging in some small talk; "how’ve you been doings" and all that. Then, as we were talking, my friend [[Luca]] and someone else walked in and came up to me. I quickly finished up my conversation with Sam and then got to talking with Luca.

They said the person with them was just a person they were dating. We went up to the bar counter and started talking for a little bit (though I don’t remember what about) but then they had to go. I was going to talk to Sam again since she was the only other person I knew, but she left as well. Because of that I decided to go home and the rest of the dream was different shots of me walking home all the way from the city until I made it home where the dream ended.
thoughts: This kind of just felt like a warm dream. The bar felt comfortable, and the catching up conversation with Sam just felt right. The same goes for Luca, though slightly less so since it wasn't "catching up." It was quite pleasant.

excerpt: I watch a Pokémon evolve.
title: The Carbink Dream
content: This dream was a screen of the [[Pokémon]] [[Carbink]] showing that it was evolving. When it finally did evolve, it evolved into the Pokémon [[Diancie]], which it normally doesn’t do. Still, it’s important to point out that the two Pokémon are connected in some way (Carbink "mutates" into Diancie or something like that).
thoughts: We've all probably watched a Pokémon evolve (at the very least, it's more likely the case if you're on this website), so this dream just mimics something that can easily be seen in real life. Heck, you could probably mimic this exact situation with a rom hack. That's all to say, this one didn't do it for me.

excerpt: I try to help my grandmother fix a TV.
title: The Wii TV Dream
content: I remember trying to help my grandmother on my dad's side fix the TV in my brother’s room (it was across the bed on the wall with the door, but I forgot to add it to the image). The TV wasn’t the one that’s actually in it, though, instead being the huge, broken grey one that used to be in my room (I don't have an image for this, but image a flat screen from before flat screens were thin). I remember that to fix it, we had to remove the component cords that plugged into the TV from the [[Wii|Nintendo Wii]], and we had to fiddle around with the HDMI ports (which that part of the TV for some reason looked like the one that’s actually in there).
thoughts: Old people and technology, huh? I love my grandparents, but at the same time, I'm not good with people who aren't good with technology. The fact that I'm a programmer means that I'm knowledgeable so hopefully I don't have to deal with other people who aren't knowledgeable (unlikely).

excerpt: I get a Wii game that doesn't exist from my dad.
title: The 80 For Brady Dream
content: This dream started with my dad handing me a game case. I looked to see what it was, and it was a copy of [[80 For Brady]] on the [[Wii]] (obviously not a real game by the by). I was slightly disappointed because it was probably a shovelware game (a game made on the cheap), and because I had never watched the movie before. I opened the case and inside was both a copy of the game and a copy of the movie, and that’s where the dream ended.
thoughts: There are a few things to note about this dream. The first is that I definitely had this dream because one of my friends was telling me about how he watched the mentioned movie, and was surprised at how much he enjoyed it. The second is that I'm pretty sure there are actual combo packs of Wii games and their movie counter parts. And, finally, I think it would be so funny if this game was real. I mean, it's not that far fetched (though, maybe a game about this specific movie is).

excerpt: My friends and I get a wish granted by a Pokémon.
title: The Arceus Playground Dream
content: Me, [[James]], [[Nina]], [[Pamela]], [[Jan]], and a bunch of other random people were all at a playground which was similar to the one from my elementary school. The [[Pokémon]] [[Arceus]] was also there, and every time someone got to it, it would grant a wish. Everybody was running around the playground chanting "God" and trying to find Arceus to get a wish granted. The last thing I remember is I think James going down a twisty slide.
thoughts: The chanting of the word "God" is probably the weirdest part of this dream to me, even with it making some sense since Arceus is the God of all Pokémon. The wish granting was also kind of interesting, and I wish I remembered what sorts of wishes were getting granted.

excerpt: I walk home from Tim Hortons.
title: The Walking From Tims Dream
content: This dream was just me walking home from [[Tim Hortons]], except I was walking through streets I’ve never been on, and taking forever to get home. Then, when I got on my street, and I was going down the hill, there were houses that I’ve never seen before. The dream then ended right when I was about to enter my home.
thoughts: This dream is probably a bit more interesting than I described it, since thee visuals of the streets were pretty liminal, but other than that, this is a pretty standard one. I will say, it did feel slightly weird in the aspect that I was walking alone, and I had this dream when I was a kid.

excerpt: I encounter Dragon Ball characters at a hospital.
title: The Dragon Ball Hospital Dream
content:
I remember being on the bottom floor of a hospital with my mom and [[Gohan]] as an adult from [[Dragon Ball Z]]. There were these big metal double doors in front of me and I opened them. They led outside, and it was nighttime, with a little bit of snow on the ground.

For some reason I left them open, and then after a while [[Piccolo]] walked in and just stood there with the rest of us. We kept standing there with the doors opened, but then I saw my friend [[Nina]] walking by. She seemed a little scared (I think it was because of Piccolo’s appearance), but I called to her and started introducing the people I was with. First my mom, then Gohan, introducing him as my son (despite me not being [[Goku]] or that even being true within the dream), and then Piccolo as my friend. Another thing to note in retrospect is that the outdoor parts remind me of the nighttime water fountain scene from [[Kanon]]. I couldn't find the exact scene I'm thinking of, but I did find something close.
thoughts: This one is kind of a random collection of stuff. From the water fountain scene looking like something out of Kanon, to the location being at a hospital, to Dragon Ball characters being there. It a bunch of random stuff that ends up making something kind of cohesive.

excerpt: I get in a Blue Brothers style chase.
title: The Blues Brothers Dream
content:
Me and two other people were running around my high school trying to not get caught by the police, very reminiscent of the movie [[The Blues Brothers|The Blues Brothers (Movie)]]. We were trying to get money to some cause, just like near the end of the film. Eventually we ran into a small room that was not in my real high school. It had a carpeted floor and a couch that we all hid under.

We could hear [[my programming teacher|Mr. High School Programming]] talking, and then he entered the room. He was looking for us, but didn’t look under the couch. We left the room and ran to the main exit, but we could see cop cars right out the front, and a police officer to our right. The other two people wanted to go out the front, but I said we should go to where the police officer was since it was only one guy.

They agreed and we all ran past him. When we got past him, he pulled out a gun and pointed it at us in a reverse grip while not facing us. We all put our hands up and turned around, and so did he. The dream ended with him asking us to take off our jackets since they had metal buttons.
thoughts: The Blues Brothers is one of my favourite movies of all time, maybe even my favourite, so having a dream in that style was really cool. It's also kind of neat that it took place at my high school. Another thing is that the ending was actually kind of scary, and felt how I imagine it would be to actually have a gun pointed at me.

excerpt: I enter Dragon Ball.
title: The Dragon Ball Lake Dream
content: I was watching [[Dragon Ball Z]] in my room at my grandmother's house on my dad's side. I remember seeing [[Piccolo]] and [[Gohan]] (specifically as a teen) on the screen, and then I got transported into the episode. Everyone (including myself) just went along with it. We were in a grassy area, and there was a very serious tone in the air, more serious than the show itself. There was a lake that we had to protect, and after this point it got foggy. I think more characters appeared, then one of them died, and the last thing I remember is crying because of that.
thoughts: Getting transported into a show/game/movie is a trope as old as the TV itself, so I'm honestly glad I had a dream involving such a concept. If I had to pick a show, I probably wouldn't pick Dragon Ball Z as my first choice, though. Not that it's bad or anything, I just have a bunch of other shows I like more. I remember the ending being quite upsetting as well, which I find it rare that a dream of mine goes from light hearted to not so much.

excerpt: I encounter Mr. Beast.
title: The Mr. Beast Dream
content: I remember going into the backyard of my grandmother's old house on my mother's side, but when I went there, the backyard was slightly different (though, I don't remember how). [[Mr. Beast]] (also, I don’t think this really matters, but I’ve never watched Mr. Beast, and this dream took place before the controversies) was there and for some reason he had a bottle of frozen mustard.
thoughts: I don't like Mr. Beast, and I don't like mustard, so there you go, this is not an all timer.

excerpt: I fuse with a Dragon Ball character.
title: The Fusion Dream
content:
I was [[Chi-Chi]] from [[Dragon Ball Z]], and [[Bulma]] was there with me. We both were wearing dresses, but we were going to a prom-like thing, and Bulma’s dress was good enough, but mine wasn’t. We both went somewhere to get new dresses, but Bulma forgot hers when I got mine, so we decided to fuse (I think using the [[Potara]] earrings).

When we got to the dance, I was myself (I don’t know what happened to who would presumably be called Chima), and there was a fight breaking out. [[Daniel]] and I were running towards it, and when we got there, Daniel turned into [[Victor]]. To break up the fight, Victor and I had to fuse (this time using the [[fusion dance]]), and right as we completed the fusion dance, I woke up.
thoughts: Add this dream to the collection of dreams where I'm a woman for some reason. Good thing I don't read too much into my dreams. I mostly just see them as a combination of memories and recent goings on, and I do think I had Dragon Ball on the mind at the time. Either way, the dream itself was pretty cool, and I liked the fusion aspect.

excerpt: I have romantic interest in one of my friends.
title: The Friends Romance Dream
content:
I gathered almost all of my friends at the side of my middle school that had the baseball field next to it (the side not shown in the image). So it was me, [[Luca]], [[James]], [[Caden]], [[Oliver]], [[Mat]], [[Pamela]] and [[Nina]]. I was standing in front of everybody so that, in the real world, the school would be to my left and the baseball field to my right. But in the dream, it was the opposite.

My announcement was that I was in love with someone in the group, but I didn’t say who. I then pointed to the baseball field bleachers and there were a bunch of people from my grade 9 class there watching us. Everyone was freaked out by them watching us, so I went over there and tipped them over, because in reality, it was just a cardboard cutout of the people. When I actually tipped it over, though, it turned into a cutout of me doing the "my honest reaction" pose (there's an image below), low quality and all.

Then, I returned to where I was previously standing and said that I was lying about my love for someone in the group (even though that wasn’t true). The last thing I remember is all of us being in a different location for a brief second before waking up.
thoughts: In real life, I did have a crush on one of my friends, though I don't think this dream had anything to do with that, since that was when I was a kid. Being a young teenager having my first female friend, I think it was only natural for a crush to occur. I'm just glad I didn't mess things up horribly. This dream kind of reminded me of that time in my life. Also, the my honest reaction image comes from one of my friends taking a panoramic image with me in it, zooming in, and then another friend making it a meme.

excerpt: I go back to high school.
title: The Programming School Dream
content: All of my friends went back to school (for a grade 13 if you will) except it had a focus on programming. The school felt different, and we were all a little older. For some reason, [[Jan]] and I were doing another AP Computer Science class. The last thing I remember is going down some stairs next an emergency exit with Jan, both of us about to go out of it. I caught her, and asked if we shared the same AP Computer Science class, and we did.
thoughts: This dream seems terrifying, but it wasn't that bad actually. I would prefer to not go back to high school again, but since this had a focus on programming, this was essentially my college experience to some degree. In that aspect, it was actually kind of nice since there was people I knew there.

excerpt: I go to a weird mall.
title: The Mall Arcade Dream
content:
I was at the same version of the mall from [[The Mall Field Trip Dream]] with my group of friends. But we were in a hallway that didn’t exist from that dream, and there were arcade machines and carnival games all around. I didn’t really want to play them for some reason, but [[Nina]] was leading the charge, so we went to each and every one.

[[Pamela]] noticed that I didn’t want to go to the machines and such, so she took me away and the two of us went on our own. We went to parts of the mall that actually did appear in the mall from the other dream, and Pamela asked me where I wanted to go. I was going to go to the used game store from that dream, but thought that she wouldn’t want to go there, so instead we went to an actual game store.
thoughts: To me, this was a very prominent dream before I started writing down my dreams. This one, along with the other mall dream were some of the few I could easily remember off the top of my head. To me, this is a modern classic, even if it isn't a top tier dream.

excerpt: I switch RPG parties.
title: The Arcueid Party Dream
content: I was at my grandmother's old house on my mom's side, and I remember standing in the living room with a party (party as in an RPG party) of people. It was two groups of four, and the only other person I knew was [[Arcueid Brunestud|Arcueid Brunestud (Tsukihime)]] from [[Tsukihime]]. We were going to switch parties with another group of people (which is something that happened in one chapter of the [[KonoSuba]] manga). The other party showed up at our front door, and as Arcueid was leaving, she was silent and mad at me. I was calling to her, and I really cared about her, but she didn’t respond and I woke up.
thoughts: Arcueid Brunestud is one of my favourite characters of all time, so any dream involving her is pretty cool. I even liked the emotional aspect, even though it was an upsetting emotional aspect. Honestly, any Tsukihime related dream is cool in my book.

excerpt: Me and a friend go inside a giant SpongeBob.
title: The SpongeBob Dream
content: My friend [[Victor]] and I were inside of a giant [[SpongeBob SquarePants|SpongeBob SquarePants (Character)]], and his insides just looked like the inside of his house. Victor was only Victor in a way, because in this dream, the way bodies worked was that no matter what soul went into them, they took on the personality of whoever was the original body. But, we had to get out of the giant SpongeBob quickly because the soul inside Victor’s body was trying to take over, and being inside the giant SpongeBob made the process go faster for some reason.
thoughts: I don't know if it's because I'm tired or what, but I was holding back chuckles as I was reading this dream again. It's just so weird that it's funny, I think. It also brings to mind images of those giant inflatable bouncy houses that are made to look like characters, which are quite funny themselves.

excerpt: I find some creepy cassette tapes.
title: The Creepy Cassettes Dream
content:
My dad brought in a bunch of milk crates full of cassette tapes, and me and my mom were looking through them while he was at work. This dream had a very creepy vibe the whole time. As we were looking through the tapes, I noticed that most of them had either a letter or a number on them as a form of indexing. I was even more scared out because that made me think that there was illegal material on them - very bad illegal material.

The crates were about up to my chest and there were two stacks of them, but out of all the tapes, I only felt comfortable taking two since they had nothing on their labels. I took them to my room to listen to them before recording over them, but as I went into my room, I heard screaming from the living room. I ran out, and it came from one of the tapes that my mom played. I put the two that I took back, feeling the most unnerved at that point throughout my entire dream, and then I woke up.
thoughts: This one is pretty much a nightmare, and not really fun retrospective kind of nightmare. It's also a very grounded dream, and could easily happen in really life, which honestly makes the dream even more scary. Terrifying indeed.

excerpt: George from Seinfeld urinates.
title: The George Seinfeld Dream
content: This dream was a weird episode of [[Seinfeld]], not me watching an episode, but an episode itself. [[George Costanza]] was in his parent's house, I believe. He yelled about something in his normal way to someone off camera. Then, he faced his back to the camera, and started peeing in the corner of the room. The credits rolled over him with his back faced, and peeing as a freeze-frame. Then, after the credits, the episode continued but all I remember is that exact same scene, but with [[Jerry Seinfeld|Jerry Seinfeld (Character)]] next to him, also peeing, and still with George who was much more relaxed.
thoughts: Obviously, this is a dangerous dream. Any dream involving a natural bodily function is scary due to the potential real world consequences. But, although I don't want to jinx it, that is seemingly not an issue for me. Still, I would rather not have such potential dangers happen, but in this case, it's slightly less dangerous since I was not a character in this dream.

excerpt: I date Kasumi Tendo from Ranma ½.
title: The Kasumi Dating Dream
content:
In this dream, I was at grandmother's house on my dad's side, and in this dream, it was [[Soun Tendo]]’s house (the dad from [[Ranma ½]]). [[Kasumi|Kasumi Tendo]] (the oldest sister) and I were planning on going on a date. I was in my room (the bottom room), and left to go to what is my brother’s room in real life (the middle room), but was Kasumi’s room in this dream.

She left the room just as I was about to enter it because she finished getting changed into her date clothes. I was wearing a dress shirt and pants, and she was wearing a nice pair of jeans and a basic shirt. I remember us leaving through the furnace room door (the door in the kitchen), and passing by Soun as we walked through the bedroom hallway. It then cut to us outside, walking down the side of the road with her now in a dress. She was talking either about how fun our dating was or was going to be.
thoughts: Off the top of my head, this is only the second dream (so far) where I date a fictional character, though I could be misremembering. It is at least two so far, though. The other that I'm thinking about is one where I date Leela, but Ranma ½ is one of my favourite series of all time, so this was a pretty cool dream to have. Funnily enough, it doesn't really have any of the main characters in it, but still, that's okay.

excerpt: I lay on a floating bed.
title: The Floating Bed Dream
content: I was in an unfamiliar room on a bed. The bed was floating in the middle of the room with me on it, and the camera angle was low and from in front of the bed. When I was on the floating bed, it also had that feeling of falling when asleep, and then being jolted awake, just without the jolted awake part.
thoughts: The feeling of falling and then being jolted awake is a classic feeling in the realm of dreams and being half asleep, so it was interesting having that feeling in this dream without being jolted awake, and it's something thats yet to happen to me again.

excerpt: I walk down a weird street at my old stomping grounds.
title: The Weird Co-Op Street Dream
content: In this dream, my family and I were still living at the co-op (basically, small apartments of 4), and I was walking down this weird street (I believe to go back home). The sidewalk was winding but flat, but everything around it was hilly, and I believe I was walking with my dad. I remember walking past that a specific apartment I used to see all the time, and my dad was talking with someone out front of the building. At the same time, I was just standing there on the sidewalk with the hilly terrain next to me.
thoughts: Since I was quite young when I lived at the co-op, I don't remember a whole lot from when I lived there, so dreams about that place are interesting to me. To be perfectly honest, since I don't remember much, it's not a time I greatly care for, which makes a dream about it all the more conflicting.

excerpt: I walk down a weird street.
title: The Weird Street Dream
content: I was walking down a street that looked kind of like the street from [[Hey Arnold!]] (despite me never really watching that show, I think I may have watched the movie, but that’s it) but in real life. I was at one end, and there were a few people in the middle of the street, I think.
thoughts: This is another dream that I would probably put in the graveyard if I wrote it down in present day. The fact that it looked so much like the Hey Arnold! street is a bit weird, since I only might have watched the movie (and clearly don't remember if I did), but other than that, that's all there is to this dream.

excerpt: A girl from an RPG tells me her story.
title: The RPG Girl Dream
content:
I remember this dream vaguely, but it’s exceptionally weird. I remember it taking place in a completely dark space with the exception of a girl who was from an RPG (not any specific RPG, it’s just one of those things where you know information in a dream that’s not explicit) and she was made of light, illuminating the dark room.

It’s kind of hard to explain, but the brightest parts made the outline of a girl, while the rest of the less bright light surrounded her. And, with retrospect, I can now easily compare the look to that one purple [[Arcueid|Arcueid Brunestud (Tsukihime)]] sprite from the [[Tsukihime]] remake (which I have an image of below). She didn’t illuminate the entire room, just the space around her.

I think that she started walking while talking to me about something important. Not the me in the dream, there was no such person. She was talking to the sleeping me in real life. As she walked, I think she walked out of the room and into another dark space, but with a blue night sky, and maybe some water that she was reflected in. She stopped there, and continued talking to me, but I woke up before she could finish. I think she was talking to me about "her world" (i.e. the RPG aspect) and how it needed saving. When I woke up is when I think she was going into the details.
thoughts: This honestly feels like what would happen if I were to die and get transported to another world. Like, I am still stunned by this dream to this day. If our real world had even the slightest fantasy aspect, this is actually what would happen to dying people, but instead, it was a dream, which may be crazier. Obviously, the "meta" aspect is that the girl was talking directly to me, but think about it, that's essentially me talking to me as someone else. I'm fairly certain this is a dream that got interrupted by my alarm waking me up rather than ending, or me not remembering the rest, and that upsets me greatly because of how interesting this dream was. I wonder if I would actually get involved in some way if the dream continued, and how that would work.

excerpt: My Math class becomes about 3D modeling.
title: The Math 3D Modelling Dream
content:
It was one of our junior high classes (I can’t remember if it was grade 8 or 9, but I don’t think it was grade 7). We were all in a class, and the room was one I had never been in before. The lights were out because we were presenting 3D models from our fellow classmates on the projector.

The overall lighting was a bit blue, exactly what you would expect on a kind of dreary day with the lights out. We were tasked with 3D modelling a hammer, and [[my math teacher|Mx. Middle School Math]] was going through our submissions on the projector. When they got to a blank slide, they started reprimanding the person who didn’t submit anything.

They said that something along the lines of how good some submissions were, and they’d also much rather a bad submission rather than none at all. While they said that, they showed a good example that was [[Mjöllnir]], and a bad example, a cylinder attached to a stick. Then, they got to another blank submission and, the person who they reprimanded was behind me, but I was only slightly in front of them while my desk was facing a different wall from everybody else.
thoughts: I think 3D modeling is pretty cool, but I don't think it's something I'm ever going to do. I like trying new things in terms of hobbies, so maybe someday, but I have a lot of hobbies I enjoy doing on a regular basis as is, and there are quite a few that I've yet to try that are higher up than 3D modeling. That said, I'm not surprised I had at least on dream about it. Having it take place in my middle school Math class is kind of interesting, and I will say that I was not a fan of the reprimanding part.

excerpt: I "wake up" from a dream.
title: The Waking Up Wall Dream
content: This dream starts with me "waking up" and noticing that my wall was a light blue, and that I had a poster of [[The Super Mario Bros. Movie]] on the wall. That was enough for me to realize I was dreaming, and I woke up. Then, I looked at my wall again, and saw that it was slightly off-white, causing me to realize that I was dreaming again and to wake up once more. I looked at the wall once more, seeing that it was normally white, and that made me think that I was awake for real. Then, I went on to have dream [[The Influencer Dream]] before waking up for real.
thoughts: I've had a similar dream in the past, and my thoughts were that although the concept of "waking up" in a dream is interesting, it's a little scary because there's nothing stopping that for going on for hours. On top of that, I find it interesting that I went on to have a dream after this within a relatively close time period, though.

excerpt: I'm in a group of influencers.
title: The Influencer Dream
content:
I was in some form of influencer house doing a challenge with a bunch of people I didn’t know. The perspective of the dream was from how a viewer would be watching the video. I also think this dream took place around Christmas. The video started off with a camera shot of a guy from the neck down as he reached down into a container on a marble kitchen table. He pulled out a piece of paper and showed it to the camera. The paper had an image of a bunch of bananas and the text "25 bananas" on it.

He started talking to the camera about how that was going to be the main ingredient for our "Christmas smoothie challenge," and then he picked out another piece of paper. The camera cut before he showed it, but I remember it being some sort of deli meat (I think either pepperoni or salami).

The next camera angle was interview style with [[Charles Martinet]] ([[Mario]]'s former voice actor), and someone asking him questions off camera. The only reason he was in the video was because we had meat in our smoothie, and Mario is Italian. The interview basically asked him about Mario and his relationship with meat.

Charles responded with something about pepperoni, and it was going along the tone of "he has a storied history." The dream cut again to a quick scene of us going on a plane to a different country. The final scene was me and 3 or 4 other people dressed as beggars, and begging to the camera before it cut to a non-video angle of us removing our beggar costumes.
thoughts: I'm not into "influencer" type social media creators, but despite that, this was an enjoyable dream. The whole smoothie challenge part was also pretty funny, and the image of that paper is just so bland that it wraps around to being funny. Same goes with Charles Martinet giving an interview about Mario's relationship with meat, though that's a little more out there.

excerpt: I find some Pokémon cards at EB Games.
title: The Loose Pokémon Cards Dream
content: I was in [[EB Games]] with my dad. I just got 50 dollars and I wanted to use it right away. I bought one of those sets with the giant cards (example below), and this one was of [[Zapdos]]. Then, we were just looking around the store, and there was a section that just had stacks of loose [[Pokémon]] cards. I started looking through them, and there were a lot of good cards. I started to take them since they were just there while looking at the employee who was at the counter. He seemed to be indifferent, so I continued to take them.
thoughts: Pokémon cards are one of those things were sometimes I'm just in the mood for them, otherwise I don't really care too much. Like, I have a lot of Pokémon cards, but only on occasion do I feel like looking at them or sorting them or whatnot. So, although I can't remember, it does make me curious as to if I was having on of those phases when I had this dream.

excerpt: My grandmother moves.
title: The Grammie Moving Dream
content: I was in my grandmother's house on my dad's side all alone with the knowledge that she was going to be moving soon. Naturally, this upset me a good deal. I also can’t remember if I was in a specific room or if the house was different in any way because of dream logic.
thoughts: My grandmother's house is a place full of memories to me. As long as I've lived, she and my grandfather have lived there, and that's been the case for my father for most of his life as well, so it's quite an old house. So, if she ever decided to move, I honestly think I would be heartbroken, even more then I felt in this dream.

excerpt: I meet an old teacher again.
title: The Middle School English Teacher Dream
content: In this dream, I met up with [[my middle school English teacher|Ms. Middle School English]] for the first time in quite a while. We were just talking about our lives, catching up, seeing how we were doing, and that kind of thing. I think we might have been at a café of some sort, but at the very least, us sitting down at a table sounds right.
thoughts: My middle school English teacher was my favourite middle school teacher, and to be brutally honest with you, I had a little bit of a crush on her back in the day. She taught me (and most of my fellow classmates) during all 3 years of middle school, so there was a nice connection made between her and her students, though very obviously not a romantic one.

excerpt: We get a new house.
title: The New House Dream
content: My dad bought a completely new, fancy, and large house. I remember exploring it, and it felt a bit confusing, but not unrealistic per se. The weirdest part was probably a set of stairs that went from a bedroom to downstairs into an entryway. It was very empty, but I was enamoured by the clean white walls and the scale of everything as I explored our new home.
thoughts: As much as I love where I currently live, my two main issues are that it's with my parents (I love them, but it's mostly because of the second issue), and that our house is quite small. Honestly, if I could have an exact replica of my current home but larger, that would be perfect. So, either a few extra rooms, or since my home is one story, a second floor with the first floor being the same as it currently is. Though, that is mostly just because I grew up there, and will love it when I get my own place no matter what.

excerpt: I have a very compact room.
title: The Compact Room Dream
content: I had a new room that was very small. It was like a tube room with enough room for a small, single person bed as well as a shelf. I remember telling my dad that my room was much too small, and that he had to expand it. I think he complained a little bit before agreeing to do it later.
thoughts: Just like the room in this dream, my thoughts on this dream are small. I have a fair amount of stuff, and my room is relatively small, so a smaller room scares me.
